dialogues.title: 缺水时谁先得到水
dialogues.scene: 水务站讨论新限水方案
dialogues.intent: 解释统一规则的差异影响
dialogues.question: 为什么统一额度不一定公平？
dialogues.answer: 家庭人数和照护需求不同。
dialogues.challenge: 居民说大家额度一样才公平，请举例回应。
rows: A
The same limit sounds fair, but families have different needs.
相同额度听起来公平，但每家的需求不同。
B
We cannot check every household. What difference matters most?
我们无法核查每家。哪种差别最重要？
A
A family caring for an older person may need extra washing.
照顾老人的家庭可能要多洗衣物。
B
Would a larger basic allowance cover that?
提高基本额度能解决吗？
A
It might, but then everyone gets more water during a shortage.
可能，但缺水时就变成人人都多用水。
B
So you prefer exceptions with a clear reason?
所以你希望有明确理由的例外？
A
Yes, with a simple application, not piles of private documents.
对，申请要简单，不用交大量私人材料。
B
We can test that while keeping the general limit.
我们可以保留总体限制，同时试行这个办法。

dialogues.title: 球场和社区菜园
dialogues.scene: 居民商量公共用水
dialogues.intent: 按用途协商紧缺资源
dialogues.question: 两人怎样减少用水？
dialogues.answer: 球场减少浇水，菜园改用收集的雨水。
dialogues.challenge: 还有儿童活动区需要水，提出新的分配原则。
rows: A
The grass will turn brown if we stop watering completely.
完全不浇水，草地就会变黄。
B
Our vegetables will die. Brown grass can recover later.
我们的蔬菜会死，黄草以后还能恢复。
A
That is true, but children still need a safe surface.
是这样，但孩子仍需要安全的场地。
B
Could you water only the areas they actually use?
能只浇孩子实际使用的区域吗？
A
Yes. Can the garden reduce its use too?
可以。菜园也能减少用水吗？
B
We have rain barrels, though they will not last all summer.
我们有雨水桶，但不够用整个夏天。
A
Let's share the savings and review the plan each week.
我们一起节水，每周检查方案。
B
Agreed. Survival comes first, then essential public use.
同意。先保证存活，再保障必要公共用途。

dialogues.title: 电费降了，租金也涨了
dialogues.scene: 租户查看屋顶太阳能方案
dialogues.intent: 区分节省和成本承担者
dialogues.question: 租户为什么仍然担心？
dialogues.answer: 电费节省可能小于租金上涨。
dialogues.challenge: 物业说整栋楼都会受益，请说明还要看什么。
rows: A
You say the panels save money, but our rent will rise.
你说太阳能板省钱，但我们的房租要涨。
B
The building needs to recover the installation cost.
大楼需要收回安装费用。
A
Will each flat save more on electricity than it pays in rent?
每户省下的电费比增加的房租多吗？
B
That depends on how much electricity the household uses.
这取决于每家的用电量。
A
Then a single rent increase could hurt people living alone.
那统一涨租可能让独居者吃亏。
B
We could share the cost according to actual savings.
我们可以按实际节省分摊成本。
A
Please show both figures, including maintenance, before we agree.
同意前请列出两项数字，包括维护费用。
B
I will send a breakdown and allow time for questions.
我会发明细，并留时间让大家提问。

dialogues.title: 共享洗衣房的账
dialogues.scene: 住户讨论换节能洗衣机
dialogues.intent: 比较投资受益与支付能力
dialogues.question: 如何避免一次性费用造成负担？
dialogues.answer: 分期支付并公布实际节省。
dialogues.challenge: 有住户从不用洗衣房，回应他的反对。
rows: A
The new machines use less power. Why is anyone against them?
新机器更省电，为什么有人反对？
B
The one-time charge is hard for some residents to afford.
有些住户付不起这笔一次性费用。
A
But everyone gets the savings eventually.
但大家最终都能省钱。
B
Eventually does not help someone short of money this month.
最终省钱帮不了这个月缺钱的人。
A
Could the building pay first and collect smaller monthly amounts?
大楼能先付，再按月少量收取吗？
B
Possibly, if the total charge and repayment period are clear.
可能，但总费用和还款期限要清楚。
A
Let's publish the bills so we can check the savings.
公布账单吧，这样能核实省了多少。
B
Good. We should also ask the residents who rarely use it.
好，也要问问很少使用的住户。

dialogues.title: 垃圾桶里的答案
dialogues.scene: 厨师和经理检查餐厅浪费
dialogues.intent: 用分类记录选择措施
dialogues.question: 为什么不直接减少所有份量？
dialogues.answer: 主要浪费来自备餐和配菜，原因不同。
dialogues.challenge: 一周后汤剩得最多，提出调查与改进。
rows: A
Our waste bill is rising. Should we make every portion smaller?
垃圾处理费在涨，要把所有份量缩小吗？
B
First, let's separate food left on plates from unused ingredients.
先把盘中剩菜和没用掉的食材分开。
A
Why would that change our decision?
这为什么会影响决定？
B
Smaller portions will not fix vegetables spoiling before we cook them.
减少份量解决不了下锅前就坏掉的蔬菜。
A
Yesterday, most plate waste seemed to be rice.
昨天盘中剩下的大多好像是米饭。
B
Then offer less rice with a free refill, not less of everything.
那就少盛米饭、免费续添，不用全部减量。
A
Let's record both categories for a week.
我们把这两类记录一周。
B
And ask customers whether the smaller serving still satisfies them.
再问顾客小份是否仍然够吃。

dialogues.title: 活动结束后的三明治
dialogues.scene: 组织者处理聚会剩余餐食
dialogues.intent: 兼顾备餐不足与食物浪费
dialogues.question: 怎样减少下次活动剩餐？
dialogues.answer: 确认人数，分批上餐，保留未拆包装。
dialogues.challenge: 临时多来二十人，提出可调整的备餐安排。
rows: A
We ordered for eighty people, but only fifty came.
我们订了八十人的餐，只有五十人来。
B
Several guests cancelled after we had already prepared the food.
我们备好餐后，有几位客人才取消。
A
Could we simply order less next time?
下次直接少订一些可以吗？
B
That risks running out when everyone arrives.
大家都来时就可能不够吃。
A
What about confirming numbers the day before?
前一天确认人数怎么样？
B
Helpful. We can also serve in batches and keep packages sealed.
有用。我们还可以分批上餐，不提前拆包装。
A
Then safe leftovers are easier to share.
那安全保存的剩餐也更容易分给别人。
B
Exactly, but we still need clear storage and collection times.
没错，不过储存和领取时间仍要明确。

dialogues.title: 离鸟巢远一点
dialogues.scene: 居民讨论湿地新步道
dialogues.intent: 协调生态保护和可达性
dialogues.question: 为什么提出短环线？
dialogues.answer: 避开鸟巢，同时给行动不便者提供路线。
dialogues.challenge: 有人要求全年开放长路线，提出有条件方案。
rows: A
The proposed path is beautiful, but it passes the nesting area.
规划的步道很美，但经过鸟类筑巢区。
B
The alternative is longer and difficult for wheelchair users.
另一条更长，轮椅使用者不容易走。
A
Could a short loop reach the viewing platform without crossing the nests?
能修短环线到观景台，又不穿过鸟巢吗？
B
It could, though visitors would see fewer parts of the wetland.
可以，但游客能看到的湿地区域会少些。
A
A useful visit does not have to cover every corner.
有收获的游览不一定要走遍每个角落。
B
Then the longer route could open after the nesting season.
那长路线可以在繁殖季过后开放。
A
With signs explaining the closure, people may understand it better.
用告示解释关闭原因，大家可能更容易理解。
B
Let's check the design with both wildlife experts and local users.
我们请生态专家和本地使用者一起审查设计。

dialogues.title: 海滩上的夜间灯光
dialogues.scene: 店主与志愿者讨论海边照明
dialogues.intent: 降低设施的生态影响
dialogues.question: 两人为什么不选择完全关灯？
dialogues.answer: 仍需保障夜间行走安全。
dialogues.challenge: 改灯费用很高，提出先实施的措施。
rows: A
People need lights to walk back from the restaurants safely.
人们从餐厅走回来需要灯光保障安全。
B
Bright lights near the sand can disturb nesting turtles.
沙滩附近的强光可能干扰筑巢的海龟。
A
Turning everything off would create another problem.
把所有灯关掉又会带来另一个问题。
B
I agree. Could the lights face down toward the path?
同意。能让灯向下照着步道吗？
A
We can change the angle, but will that be enough?
可以调整角度，但这样够吗？
B
We should also check brightness and close the beach path at night.
还要检查亮度，并在夜间关闭沙滩步道。
A
An inland route would keep customers away from the nests.
走内侧路线就能让顾客远离鸟巢。
B
Let's test the lighting and monitor the nesting area.
我们试试照明调整，同时观察筑巢区域。

dialogues.title: 自带杯真的更好吗
dialogues.scene: 顾客询问咖啡店的杯子政策
dialogues.intent: 解释完整使用过程的影响
dialogues.question: 判断杯子影响还需要看什么？
dialogues.answer: 使用次数、清洗和丢失情况。
dialogues.challenge: 朋友每天买新环保杯，请解释你的看法。
rows: A
This cup says reusable. Does that automatically make it greener?
这杯子写着可重复使用，就一定更环保吗？
B
Only if you actually use it enough times.
得真的用足够多次才行。
A
So making it also uses energy?
所以生产它也消耗能源？
B
Yes, and washing matters too. The whole process counts.
对，清洗也重要。要看整个过程。
A
I keep buying new cups because I leave mine at home.
我老把杯子忘在家里，只好买新的。
B
Keeping one at work might be better than buying another.
放一个在公司，可能比继续买更好。
A
What about your returnable cups?
你们可以归还的杯子呢？
B
They work when people return them, so we track losses as well.
大家归还才有用，所以我们也记录丢失情况。

dialogues.title: 送餐盒要不要换
dialogues.scene: 餐馆讨论可归还餐盒
dialogues.intent: 把环境目标落实到回收流程
dialogues.question: 小范围试行要记录什么？
dialogues.answer: 归还率、清洗用量和运输距离。
dialogues.challenge: 归还率只有一半，提出改进或暂停的条件。
rows: A
Let's replace every takeaway box with a returnable one.
把所有外卖盒都换成可归还的吧。
B
How will customers send them back? Extra trips could add costs.
顾客怎么归还？额外跑一趟会增加成本。
A
Drivers could collect them with the next order.
配送员可以在下次送餐时收走。
B
That helps regular customers. Some people order only once.
常客方便，有些人只点一次。
A
Then let's start with offices that order every week.
那先从每周订餐的办公室开始。
B
And record returns, washing water, and driving distance.
并记录归还情况、清洗用水和行车距离。
A
If those look reasonable, we can expand gradually.
这些指标合理的话，再逐渐扩大。
B
Good. A promising label is not the same as a working system.
好。标签看着好，不代表整套办法有效。

dialogues.title: 窗边那盆长得快
dialogues.scene: 学生设计植物观察
dialogues.intent: 把直觉变成可检验的比较
dialogues.question: 原比较有什么问题？
dialogues.answer: 光照和浇水同时不同。
dialogues.challenge: 换成肥料研究，说明怎样安排比较。
rows: A
The plant by the window grew faster. Sunlight must be the reason.
窗边那盆长得更快，一定是阳光的作用。
B
Perhaps. Did both plants get the same amount of water?
可能。两盆浇的水一样多吗？
A
No. I watered that one more because it looked dry.
不一样。那盆看着干，我多浇了些。
B
Then we changed two things, so we cannot separate their effects.
那我们改变了两项，无法分清各自影响。
A
I'll use several similar plants and keep watering equal.
我会用几盆相似的植物，保持浇水相同。
B
Good. Also measure them at the same time each week.
好，还要每周同一时间测量。
A
If the window group grows more, can we draw a conclusion?
如果窗边那组长得更快，就能下结论吗？
B
We would have stronger evidence, though we should repeat the test.
证据会更充分，不过还应重复测试。

dialogues.title: 新睡前习惯
dialogues.scene: 朋友讨论睡眠变化
dialogues.intent: 识别同时发生的变化
dialogues.question: 为什么不能归功于关手机？
dialogues.answer: 同时减少了咖啡并改变睡觉时间。
dialogues.challenge: 设计一个自己能坚持的小观察。
rows: A
I slept better after I stopped using my phone in bed.
不在床上用手机后，我睡得更好了。
B
Did anything else change that week?
那周还改变了别的事情吗？
A
I also drank less coffee and went to bed earlier.
我还少喝了咖啡，提前睡了。
B
Then the phone may not explain the whole improvement.
那手机可能解释不了全部改善。
A
Should I go back to all my old habits?
我要恢复所有旧习惯吗？
B
No. Keep a record and change one habit at a time.
不用。做个记录，一次改一个习惯。
A
I could note bedtime, coffee, and how rested I feel.
我可以记睡觉时间、咖啡量和精神状态。
B
Exactly. It will guide you without pretending to prove everything.
对。能给你参考，不必声称证明了一切。

dialogues.title: 同样实验，不同结果
dialogues.scene: 研究生核对植物实验
dialogues.intent: 提出可检验的不一致解释
dialogues.question: 他们先检查什么？
dialogues.answer: 种子年龄和培养条件。
dialogues.challenge: 第二次仍不一致，提出下一步而不指责他人。
rows: A
Our plants barely changed. Their report showed a clear increase.
我们的植物几乎没变化，他们的报告却明显增长。
B
Before questioning the report, let's compare the exact conditions.
质疑报告前，先对比具体条件。
A
We used the same temperature and the same brand of seeds.
温度和种子品牌都相同。
B
But their seeds were fresh. Ours were stored for a year.
但他们用新种子，我们的存了一年。
A
Would age alone explain such a large difference?
只靠种子年龄就能解释这么大的差别吗？
B
We do not know. We can test fresh and stored seeds together.
不知道。可以同时测试新种子和旧种子。
A
I'll ask whether they recorded humidity as well.
我再问问他们是否记录了湿度。
B
Good. Different results can help us find hidden conditions.
好。不同结果能帮我们找出隐藏条件。

dialogues.title: 照菜谱也做不一样
dialogues.scene: 朋友比较烘焙结果
dialogues.intent: 核查方法差异
dialogues.question: 为什么先检查烤箱温度？
dialogues.answer: 显示温度可能不等于实际温度。
dialogues.challenge: 温度没有问题，继续提出两个具体检查。
rows: A
I followed your recipe, but my cake sank in the middle.
我照你的配方做，中间却塌了。
B
When did you open the oven door?
你什么时候打开烤箱门的？
A
Halfway through. I wanted to see whether it was ready.
烤到一半。我想看看好了没有。
B
That might matter, but let's check the temperature too.
这可能有影响，但也检查一下温度。
A
The display said exactly what your recipe said.
显示温度和配方写的一模一样。
B
Displays can be inaccurate. Mine runs slightly hotter.
显示可能不准，我的实际温度略高。
A
I'll use a thermometer and leave the door closed next time.
下次我用温度计，也不打开门。
B
Change one thing first, or we will not know what helped.
先改一项，不然不知道哪项起了作用。

dialogues.title: 马上有用还是以后有用
dialogues.scene: 委员会讨论研究资助
dialogues.intent: 比较短期效益与长期价值
dialogues.question: 为什么不把经费全部给过滤项目？
dialogues.answer: 基础研究也可能改善未来方案。
dialogues.challenge: 预算再少三成，说明取舍与保留条件。
rows: A
The water filter project could help households this year.
净水器项目今年就可能帮助家庭。
B
True, but the basic study may explain why filters fail.
对，但基础研究可能解释净水器为什么失效。
A
People need safe water now, not a possible answer later.
人们现在就需要安全用水，不是未来可能的答案。
B
I agree about urgency. Does that justify cancelling every long-term study?
我认同紧迫性，但这能证明该取消所有长期研究吗？
A
No. Could we fund a smaller first stage for each?
不能。可以各资助规模较小的第一阶段吗？
B
Yes, with different milestones rather than the same deadline.
可以，设置不同阶段目标，不必统一期限。
A
The filter team should demonstrate safe performance first.
净水器团队应先展示安全性能。
B
And the basic team should share useful methods even without a breakthrough.
基础研究团队即使没突破，也应分享有用方法。

dialogues.title: 团队培训怎么花钱
dialogues.scene: 经理讨论培训预算
dialogues.intent: 权衡眼前技能与未来适应
dialogues.question: 最后怎样组合培训？
dialogues.answer: 急需技能短课与长期学习小组结合。
dialogues.challenge: 员工说长期培训没有用，回应并举例。
rows: A
We need software training. Why spend money on general problem-solving?
我们需要软件培训，为什么花钱练一般问题解决？
B
The software changes, but people still need to adapt.
软件会变，人们仍需要适应变化。
A
That sounds sensible, yet this month's work is already late.
听着有道理，但这个月的工作已拖延。
B
Then start with a short course on the tools we use now.
那先上目前工具的短期课程。
A
And postpone the broader course?
把更广泛的课程推迟吗？
B
We could run a low-cost learning group alongside it.
可以同时开展低成本学习小组。
A
What would show that the group is useful?
怎么证明小组有用？
B
Ask teams to document one problem they solved differently.
请团队记录一个采用不同方法解决的问题。

dialogues.title: 讲座标题太满了
dialogues.scene: 研究员准备公众讲座
dialogues.intent: 表达初步发现和限制
dialogues.question: 为什么要改标题？
dialogues.answer: 小规模研究不能支持对所有人的确定结论。
dialogues.challenge: 把“这种习惯让所有人更快乐”改成准确口语。
rows: A
How about 'A Simple Walk Makes Everyone Happier'?
标题用“简单散步让每个人更快乐”怎样？
B
Everyone is too strong. We studied only thirty volunteers.
每个人太绝对了，我们只研究了三十位志愿者。
A
But a cautious title may attract fewer people.
但谨慎的标题可能吸引不了那么多人。
B
We can be interesting without promising more than we know.
可以吸引人，但别承诺超出已知范围。
A
'What a Small Walking Study Tells Us' might work.
“一项小型散步研究告诉了我们什么”可能合适。
B
Yes. Explain what changed and what we still cannot tell.
可以。解释哪些变化了，哪些还无法判断。
A
Should we mention that the volunteers chose to join?
需要提到志愿者自己选择参加吗？
B
Definitely. They may already have been interested in exercise.
一定要。他们可能本来就对运动有兴趣。

dialogues.title: 新品宣传的边界
dialogues.scene: 员工审查护肤品介绍
dialogues.intent: 将试用结果转成有限声明
dialogues.question: 他们能准确说什么？
dialogues.answer: 参与试用的大多数人报告皮肤更柔软。
dialogues.challenge: 顾客问是否保证有效，请自然回答。
rows: A
Can we say the cream works for all skin types?
能说这款乳霜适合所有肤质吗？
B
Not from this trial. We included only people with dry skin.
不能根据这次试用这么说，我们只招了干性肤质的人。
A
Most of them reported softer skin, though.
不过大多数人都说皮肤更柔软了。
B
Then say that, and explain it was their own assessment.
那就这样说，并说明是他们的自我评价。
A
Would mentioning the limits make customers distrust us?
提局限会让顾客不信任我们吗？
B
Clear limits help them decide whether the result applies to them.
讲清局限能帮助他们判断结果是否适用。
A
I'll remove the guarantee and describe the actual trial.
我会去掉保证，描述实际试用情况。
B
Good. Confidence should come from the evidence, not the wording.
好。信心应来自证据，而不是措辞。

dialogues.title: 鸟更多还是人更多
dialogues.scene: 志愿者与研究员看观鸟记录
dialogues.intent: 区分记录增加与真实变化
dialogues.question: 为什么记录增加不能直接说明鸟增多？
dialogues.answer: 观察者和观察时间也增加了。
dialogues.challenge: 雨天记录很少，提出至少两种解释。
rows: A
We logged twice as many birds this spring. The park must be improving.
今年春天记录的鸟翻倍了，公园肯定改善了。
B
Maybe, but we also had twice as many volunteers.
可能，但志愿者人数也翻倍了。
A
So the extra records could just reflect extra observers?
所以记录增加可能只是因为观察者更多？
B
Yes. We need to compare similar routes and observation times.
对。要比较相似路线和观察时长。
A
Some volunteers wait an hour; others stay ten minutes.
有些志愿者等一小时，另一些只待十分钟。
B
Let's add duration and weather to the recording form.
在记录表加上时长和天气吧。
A
Does that mean our older records are useless?
那旧记录就没用了吗？
B
No. They show where birds were seen, with limits on comparison.
不是。它们显示发现鸟的位置，但比较时有限制。

dialogues.title: 道路投诉少了
dialogues.scene: 社区讨论道路维修效果
dialogues.intent: 核查观测方式变化
dialogues.question: 投诉下降还有什么解释？
dialogues.answer: 网上表单故障使投诉更困难。
dialogues.challenge: 提出确认维修效果的实际办法。
rows: A
Pothole complaints fell after the repairs. That looks encouraging.
维修后坑洞投诉减少了，看起来令人鼓舞。
B
The online complaint form has been broken for two weeks.
网上投诉表单已经坏了两周。
A
I did not know. Then the numbers may be misleading.
我不知道，那这些数字可能误导。
B
People are still talking about the side streets.
人们还在说旁边几条街的问题。
A
We should inspect those roads instead of relying only on complaints.
应检查那些道路，不能只靠投诉。
B
And offer a phone number until the form works again.
表单恢复前也要提供联系电话。
A
We'll compare conditions on the same streets before and after.
我们会比较同样街道维修前后的情况。
B
That would tell us more about the repairs themselves.
这能更好地了解维修本身的效果。

dialogues.title: 限流后的早晨
dialogues.scene: 古城讨论游客预约
dialogues.intent: 协调收入和生活空间
dialogues.question: 为何不只限制总人数？
dialogues.answer: 拥挤还与时间和路线有关。
dialogues.challenge: 商户担心收入下降，提出可检查的试行办法。
rows: A
By nine, residents cannot even reach the bakery.
九点时居民连面包店都挤不过去。
B
Visitor spending keeps many local businesses open.
游客消费让很多本地商店得以经营。
A
I understand. Could we spread arrivals across the day?
我理解。能把到达时间分散到全天吗？
B
Timed tickets may help, though tour groups prefer mornings.
分时票可能有用，不过旅行团偏爱上午。
A
Then offer cheaper afternoon tickets and protect delivery hours.
那提供较便宜的下午票，保留送货时间。
B
Would residents accept more visitors on the quieter streets?
居民能接受较安静街道多来些游客吗？
A
Only after asking those residents. Moving crowds also moves noise.
要先问当地居民。人群转移，噪音也会转移。
B
Let's trial the schedule and track both shop income and crowding.
我们试行时间安排，同时记录商店收入和拥挤情况。

dialogues.title: 山村的周末停车
dialogues.scene: 村民和民宿经营者协商停车
dialogues.intent: 避免将游客成本转给居民
dialogues.question: 接驳车为什么有条件？
dialogues.answer: 需可靠运行并给居民保留通行。
dialogues.challenge: 游客不愿坐接驳车，提出有说服力的解释。
rows: A
Visitors park outside my gate every Saturday.
每周六都有游客停在我家门口。
B
They struggle to find spaces near the guesthouses.
他们在民宿附近找不到车位。
A
Could they park at the entrance and take a shuttle?
能停在村口，再坐接驳车吗？
B
Yes, but an unreliable shuttle would damage our business.
可以，但接驳车不准时会影响生意。
A
Publish departure times and add trips on busy weekends.
公布发车时间，忙碌周末增加班次。
B
Then we need funding from the guesthouses and parking fees.
那需要民宿和停车费共同出资。
A
Residents must still be able to drive home without a charge.
居民仍要能免费开车回家。
B
Agreed. I'll propose resident permits and review delays monthly.
同意。我会建议居民通行证，并每月检查延误。

dialogues.title: 展签少了谁的声音
dialogues.scene: 策展人与社区代表审查展签
dialogues.intent: 协调解释权与历史证据
dialogues.question: 代表要求哪些改变？
dialogues.answer: 加入当代用途，并共同审核展签。
dialogues.challenge: 两方对物品意义意见不同，提出呈现办法。
rows: A
Our label describes the object as a ceremonial bowl.
展签把这件物品描述为仪式用碗。
B
That is incomplete. Families still use similar bowls today.
这不完整。如今家庭仍使用类似的碗。
A
The old collection notes mention only ceremonies.
旧收藏笔记只提到了仪式。
B
Those notes reflect what one visitor understood, not our whole history.
笔记反映一位访客的理解，不是我们全部历史。
A
Would you help us add the current uses?
你愿意帮我们补充今天的用途吗？
B
Yes, but our community should also review the final wording.
愿意，但社区也应审核最终措辞。
A
We can show both the historical record and your explanation.
我们可以同时呈现历史记录和你们的解释。
B
And make clear where the accounts differ, rather than hiding it.
还要说清叙述分歧，不要把它藏起来。

dialogues.title: 街区墙上的老照片
dialogues.scene: 居民策划街区历史展
dialogues.intent: 用多种记忆补充历史叙述
dialogues.question: 为什么不能只选繁荣照片？
dialogues.answer: 会忽视迁离和困难经历。
dialogues.challenge: 一位居民不愿公开名字，提出尊重他的方式。
rows: A
These photographs show how lively the old market was.
这些照片显示旧市场多么热闹。
B
They do, but the display leaves out families who were forced to move.
是，但展览漏掉了被迫搬走的家庭。
A
We wanted to celebrate the neighborhood.
我们想赞美这个街区。
B
Celebrating it does not require leaving out difficult memories.
赞美它并不需要省略艰难的记忆。
A
Could we invite people to record their own stories?
可以邀请人们讲自己的故事吗？
B
Yes. Let them approve the recordings before you publish them.
可以。公开前让他们确认录音。
A
Some stories may contradict each other.
有些故事可能互相矛盾。
B
That is part of the history. Explain whose memory each story reflects.
那也是历史的一部分。注明每段是谁的记忆。

dialogues.title: 赞助商要换节目
dialogues.scene: 节庆筹备者讨论赞助条件
dialogues.intent: 协商资金与文化自主
dialogues.question: 什么条件不可接受？
dialogues.answer: 赞助商决定表演内容和服装。
dialogues.challenge: 赞助商威胁撤资，说明可让步与不可让步之处。
rows: A
The sponsor will cover the stage if we shorten the traditional songs.
如果缩短传统歌曲，赞助商愿付舞台费用。
B
How short? Some stories lose their meaning without the final verse.
缩短多少？有些故事少了最后一段就失去意义。
A
They want a faster show and their logo on our costumes.
他们想节奏更快，并在服装上放标志。
B
A sign beside the stage is different from changing the performance.
舞台旁放广告牌和改表演不是一回事。
A
Could a separate short introduction satisfy their schedule?
单独做个简短介绍，能满足时间安排吗？
B
Possibly, if performers choose the content and keep the full songs.
可能，前提是表演者选内容，歌曲保持完整。
A
I'll offer signs and an introduction, but no costume branding.
我会提议广告牌和介绍，不在服装上加标志。
B
And check the agreement before we announce the sponsorship.
公布赞助前还要核对协议。

dialogues.title: 手工课变成表演秀
dialogues.scene: 工匠讨论游客体验活动
dialogues.intent: 保护真实技艺和劳动价值
dialogues.question: 工匠为什么拒绝十分钟课程？
dialogues.answer: 时间不足以学习，会把技艺变成噱头。
dialogues.challenge: 游客只能停留半小时，设计诚实的体验。
rows: A
Could you teach each visitor to make a basket in ten minutes?
能十分钟教每位游客编一个篮子吗？
B
Not honestly. That skill takes practice, and ten minutes is a demonstration.
做不到。需要练习，十分钟只能展示。
A
Visitors want something to take home.
游客想带点东西回去。
B
They could try a small section and see a finished basket.
他们可以试编一小段，再看完整篮子。
A
Would you sell them finished pieces afterward?
之后能卖成品给他们吗？
B
Yes, provided the price includes our time and materials fairly.
可以，但价格要合理体现工时和材料。
A
I'll describe it as an introduction, not a complete course.
我会写成入门体验，不称为完整课程。
B
Then people can enjoy it without misunderstanding the craft.
那大家能享受体验，也不会误解这门技艺。

dialogues.title: 地名背后的故事
dialogues.scene: 导游设计双语步行路线
dialogues.intent: 兼顾理解与语言可见度
dialogues.question: 为什么保留原地名？
dialogues.answer: 翻译会遗漏声音和文化关联。
dialogues.challenge: 游客说原词难记，用简明方式回应。
rows: A
Could we translate every local name into English?
能把所有本地名称译成英语吗？
B
We can explain them, but replacing them loses something.
可以解释，但完全替换会丢失一些东西。
A
Visitors need to understand where they are going.
游客需要知道自己要去哪里。
B
Use both names, and explain one interesting detail at each stop.
两种名称都用，每站解释一个有趣细节。
A
Would asking visitors to repeat the name feel awkward?
请游客跟着念会不会尴尬？
B
Make it an invitation. Hearing the sound can make the place memorable.
用邀请的语气。听到发音能让地方更难忘。
A
Some meanings do not have an exact English equivalent.
有些意思没有准确的英语对应词。
B
Then use a short story rather than a misleading single word.
那就用小故事解释，不要用误导的单个词。

dialogues.title: 餐厅菜单怎么翻
dialogues.scene: 店主和翻译讨论菜单
dialogues.intent: 保留文化信息并提供实际帮助
dialogues.question: 菜单怎样帮助陌生顾客？
dialogues.answer: 保留菜名并说明食材和做法。
dialogues.challenge: 一道菜名字像甜品却是咸菜，写出解释。
rows: A
The English name you suggested sounds like ordinary soup.
你建议的英文名称听着像普通汤。
B
It is familiar, but it does not capture the local name.
容易理解，但没有体现本地名称。
A
I want visitors to know what they are ordering.
我想让游客知道点的是什么。
B
Keep the original name, then describe the ingredients and cooking method.
保留原名，再写食材和做法。
A
Should we include the story behind the dish?
要加上这道菜的故事吗？
B
A short note would help, but allergy information comes first.
简短说明有用，但过敏信息要优先。
A
So the menu can be practical and still show our identity.
所以菜单既能实用，也能体现我们的特色。
B
Exactly. Clear explanations do not require erasing local names.
没错。解释清楚不需要抹去本地名称。

dialogues.title: 旺季过后怎么办
dialogues.scene: 酒店员工讨论就业发展
dialogues.intent: 区分岗位数量与就业质量
dialogues.question: 员工最担心什么？
dialogues.answer: 旺季过后没有稳定工时和收入。
dialogues.challenge: 新增酒店承诺一百个岗位，提出三个问题。
rows: A
The town says tourism created hundreds of jobs. Mine ends in October.
镇上说旅游创造了几百个岗位，我的十月就结束。
B
The figures count seasonal positions as well as permanent ones.
数字把季节性和长期岗位都算进去了。
A
Then the total does not show whether people can pay rent all year.
那总数看不出人们能否全年付房租。
B
We should report hours, pay, and contract length too.
还应报告工时、工资和合同期限。
A
Could training help us find different work in winter?
培训能帮我们冬天找其他工作吗？
B
It could, if there are employers needing those skills.
可以，前提是确实有雇主需要这些技能。
A
Please talk to them before offering another generic course.
再开普通培训班前，请先问问那些雇主。
B
Agreed. Training alone cannot create demand for workers.
同意。只靠培训不能创造用工需求。

dialogues.title: 节庆摊位的机会
dialogues.scene: 青年和社区负责人讨论摆摊
dialogues.intent: 评估临时机会的长期价值
dialogues.question: 为什么低摊位费不够？
dialogues.answer: 经营者还承担库存和准备成本。
dialogues.challenge: 设计一种减少首次经营风险的支持。
rows: A
The festival offers cheap stalls. Is this a good way to start my business?
节庆摊位便宜，适合开始创业吗？
B
It could help you test demand, but what costs come before opening?
可能帮助测试需求，但开摊前有哪些成本？
A
Ingredients, equipment, and two weeks preparing products.
食材、设备，还要用两周准备产品。
B
And will you have customers after the festival ends?
节庆结束后还会有顾客吗？
A
I could take orders, if people enjoy the food.
大家喜欢的话，我可以继续接订单。
B
Then collect feedback and contact details with permission.
那收集反馈，并经同意留下联系方式。
A
Could beginners share equipment to reduce the risk?
新手可以共用设备降低风险吗？
B
Yes. Let's support the next step, not just the festival day.
可以。我们支持后续发展，不只支持节庆当天。

dialogues.title: 房子多了，学校够吗
dialogues.scene: 居民讨论新公寓计划
dialogues.intent: 联系住房供给与配套容量
dialogues.question: 居民支持方案的条件是什么？
dialogues.answer: 明确学校和交通扩容时间及资金。
dialogues.challenge: 有人主张任何新住房都不建，回应并提出条件。
rows: A
We need cheaper housing, but the school is already full.
我们需要便宜住房，但学校已经满了。
B
More apartments can help, and the plan includes extra classrooms.
增加公寓有帮助，计划也包含新教室。
A
Before residents move in, or several years afterward?
是在居民入住前，还是几年之后？
B
The current schedule puts the apartments first.
目前安排是公寓先建。
A
Then existing families carry the pressure while the developer gets paid.
那开发商收了钱，现有家庭却承担压力。
B
We could link each building stage to school and transport improvements.
可以把每个建设阶段与学校、交通改善挂钩。
A
With funding secured, not just a promise in a brochure?
要落实资金，不只是宣传册里的承诺。
B
Yes. Let's make those conditions public before approval.
对。批准前把这些条件公开。

dialogues.title: 社区门诊搬去哪
dialogues.scene: 居民与卫生服务人员讨论搬迁
dialogues.intent: 比较设施规模和实际可达性
dialogues.question: 新址面积更大为何仍有问题？
dialogues.answer: 现有患者可能难以到达。
dialogues.challenge: 提出兼顾服务扩容和老患者的办法。
rows: A
The new clinic is larger, but it is two bus rides away.
新门诊更大，但要换两次公交。
B
The current building cannot hold the extra services we need.
现有大楼容纳不了新增服务。
A
For older patients, a longer journey may mean missing appointments.
对老年患者，更远可能意味着无法赴约。
B
Would a direct bus solve the problem?
直达公交能解决吗？
A
Partly. People also need frequent departures and accessible stops.
部分可以，还需要班次充足和方便通行的车站。
B
Perhaps basic appointments could remain at a small local branch.
也许基础问诊可以保留在小型本地分点。
A
That would help. Ask patients which services they use most.
那有帮助。问问患者最常用哪些服务。
B
We will compare travel time as well as building capacity.
我们会同时比较出行时间和楼宇容量。

dialogues.title: 谁愿意领取午餐补助
dialogues.scene: 校长与家长讨论校餐
dialogues.intent: 比较普惠与定向支持
dialogues.question: 符合条件者为什么没有申请？
dialogues.answer: 手续复杂且担心被区别对待。
dialogues.challenge: 预算无法覆盖所有人，设计更容易领取的方案。
rows: A
Targeted meals cost less than giving everyone free lunch.
定向供餐比让所有人免费吃午餐便宜。
B
But several eligible families never applied.
但几户符合条件的家庭从未申请。
A
Do they not know about the support?
他们不知道有这项支持吗？
B
Some do. The forms are difficult, and children fear being singled out.
有些知道。表格难填，孩子也怕被区别对待。
A
Universal meals would remove that distinction, but we lack the budget.
普惠供餐能去掉区别，但预算不够。
B
Could you simplify enrollment and use the same payment system for everyone?
能简化申请，并让大家使用相同支付系统吗？
A
We can check eligibility privately and stop using separate lunch cards.
可以私下审核资格，取消不同的午餐卡。
B
Then measure participation, not just how many families qualify.
之后要看参与率，不只看符合条件的人数。

dialogues.title: 免费课程有没有人来
dialogues.scene: 社区讨论成人课程补助
dialogues.intent: 识别资格和实际参与的差距
dialogues.question: 为什么免费仍无法吸引参加？
dialogues.answer: 上课时间与照护责任冲突。
dialogues.challenge: 只能增加一项支持，说明你的选择与理由。
rows: A
The course is free for low-income residents, yet attendance is low.
低收入居民免费上课，但出勤率很低。
B
Most sessions are during working hours.
多数课程在工作时间进行。
A
Even the evening session has empty seats.
晚上的课程也有空位。
B
Parents may need childcare. Free tuition does not remove every cost.
家长可能需要托儿。免学费不能去除所有成本。
A
We could offer recorded lessons for flexible study.
可以提供录播，方便灵活学习。
B
Useful, but some learners need help using the website.
有用，但部分学员需要网站操作帮助。
A
Let's ask non-attenders what would make joining possible.
问问没来的人，需要什么才方便参加。
B
Yes. Let their answers guide the support, rather than guessing.
对。根据回答提供支持，不要猜。

dialogues.title: 收费之后的替代路线
dialogues.scene: 通勤者讨论拥堵收费
dialogues.intent: 解释激励与替代选择
dialogues.question: 通勤者为什么无法直接换公交？
dialogues.answer: 轮班时间没有公交服务。
dialogues.challenge: 预算有限，提出收费收入优先用途。
rows: A
Charging drivers may reduce traffic, but my shift starts before the buses.
收费可能减堵，但我上班时公交还没开。
B
The policy is intended to encourage public transport.
这项政策希望鼓励公共交通。
A
That only works when a realistic alternative exists.
得有可行替代方式才起作用。
B
Would an early bus route change your decision?
开一条早班路线能改变你的决定吗？
A
Yes, if it runs reliably and reaches the industrial area.
可以，前提是可靠运行并到达工业区。
B
We could use part of the revenue for shift workers' routes.
可以用部分收入开轮班工人需要的路线。
A
Before the charge starts, please. Otherwise we pay while waiting.
请在收费开始前落实，不然我们只能边交钱边等。
B
I'll propose a phased start linked to those improvements.
我会建议随配套改善分阶段实施收费。

dialogues.title: 校园停车位涨价
dialogues.scene: 员工讨论校园停车政策
dialogues.intent: 避免一刀切增加负担
dialogues.question: 员工提出哪种支持？
dialogues.answer: 改善交通并提供有条件例外。
dialogues.challenge: 多人要求免费停车，提出合理审核原则。
rows: A
Higher parking fees might reduce cars, but I carry heavy equipment.
停车费上涨可能减少车辆，但我要搬重设备。
B
We cannot keep every space cheap. The car park is always full.
不能让每个车位都便宜，停车场一直满。
A
I am asking for delivery access, not a permanent free space.
我要的是搬运通道，不是永久免费车位。
B
A short loading permit could cover that need.
短时装卸许可可以解决。
A
And colleagues with limited mobility need a different arrangement.
行动不便的同事也需要不同安排。
B
We should separate essential access from ordinary commuting.
应区分必要通行和日常通勤。
A
Could the extra fees improve the campus shuttle?
增加的费用可以改善校园班车吗？
B
Yes. I'll publish the spending plan alongside the new charges.
可以。我会随新收费公布支出计划。

dialogues.title: 网线到了，电脑在哪
dialogues.scene: 社区评估宽带计划
dialogues.intent: 区分覆盖和使用条件
dialogues.question: 为什么覆盖率不是唯一指标？
dialogues.answer: 居民还需要付费能力、设备和使用技能。
dialogues.challenge: 新增覆盖或提供设备只能选一项，解释选择。
rows: A
Your map says every home is covered. Many residents still cannot get online.
地图显示家家有覆盖，但许多居民仍上不了网。
B
The cable reaches every building. What is stopping them?
网线已到每栋楼。是什么阻碍他们？
A
Monthly fees, old devices, and trouble setting up accounts.
月费、旧设备，还有开账户的困难。
B
We offer a low-cost plan, but few people request it.
我们有低价套餐，但很少有人申请。
A
They may not know it exists, or may find the application confusing.
他们可能不知道，或者觉得申请复杂。
B
Could your center help people sign up?
你们中心能帮人注册吗？
A
Yes, with clear prices and no unexpected charges later.
可以，但价格要清楚，之后不能突然收费。
B
Let's track actual connections and use, not just cable coverage.
我们记录实际接通和使用情况，不只看网线覆盖。

dialogues.title: 预约只能用手机
dialogues.scene: 诊所讨论线上预约
dialogues.intent: 保留多种服务通道
dialogues.question: 什么办法避免数字排除？
dialogues.answer: 保留电话和现场预约并提供指导。
dialogues.challenge: 经理说电话预约成本高，提出折中。
rows: A
Online booking reduces queues. Why are patients still unhappy?
线上预约减少排队，患者为什么仍不满意？
B
Some cannot use the app, and the phone line was removed.
有人不会用应用，电话通道又取消了。
A
We could give them a guide at reception.
可以在前台给他们操作指南。
B
A guide will not help someone without a smartphone.
没有智能手机的人拿到指南也没用。
A
Then we should keep phone and walk-in appointments available.
那应该保留电话和现场预约。
B
Yes, while offering patient support for people who want to learn.
对，同时耐心帮助愿意学习的人。
A
We can reserve staff time rather than answer calls all day.
可以设置专门接电话时间，不用全天接听。
B
As long as urgent callers still have a clear route to help.
但紧急求助者仍要有明确渠道获得帮助。

dialogues.title: 开会的人代表谁
dialogues.scene: 社区改进居民预算会议
dialogues.intent: 扩大真实参与
dialogues.question: 什么人没有参加？
dialogues.answer: 夜班工人和带孩子的家长。
dialogues.challenge: 不能增加会议次数，提出其他参与方式。
rows: A
The meeting was open to everyone, so the vote seems fair.
会议向所有人开放，所以投票似乎公平。
B
Open does not mean everyone could attend at six o'clock.
开放不代表人人六点都能来。
A
Who was missing?
哪些人没来？
B
Night workers and parents collecting children, among others.
比如夜班工人和接孩子的家长。
A
We could add an online vote.
可以增加网上投票。
B
And paper forms at the library for residents without internet access.
也在图书馆放纸质表格，方便不上网的居民。
A
Should we delay the decision until those responses arrive?
要等这些反馈来了再做决定吗？
B
Yes. Otherwise extra participation would not change anything.
要。不然增加参与也改变不了任何事。

dialogues.title: 孩子想要怎样的公园
dialogues.scene: 家长和设计师讨论公园改造
dialogues.intent: 听取直接使用者意见
dialogues.question: 为何不只问家长？
dialogues.answer: 孩子实际使用空间，需求可能不同。
dialogues.challenge: 孩子提出不安全的设施，怎样尊重意见并解释限制？
rows: A
Most parents chose more benches. Shall we finalize the design?
多数家长选更多长椅，可以定稿了吗？
B
Have you asked the children who actually play there?
问过真正在那里玩的孩子吗？
A
We assumed parents would speak for them.
我们以为家长会代表他们。
B
My daughter wants a quiet place to read, not another climbing frame.
我女儿想要安静阅读的地方，不是另一个攀爬架。
A
How can we ask younger children without giving them difficult forms?
怎么问小孩子，又不用让他们填难懂的表格？
B
Let them draw ideas and explain what they do in the park.
让他们画想法，并说说在公园做什么。
A
We should show which ideas we adopted afterward.
之后应该展示采用了哪些想法。
B
And explain the reasons when an idea is not possible.
如果想法无法实现，也要解释原因。

dialogues.title: 咖啡让人学习更久吗
dialogues.scene: 学生讨论校园商店记录
dialogues.intent: 识别相关与反向解释
dialogues.question: 咖啡购买和学习时长可能怎样关联？
dialogues.answer: 学习久的人可能本来就更常买咖啡。
dialogues.challenge: 给出第三种解释并说明怎样核查。
rows: A
Students who buy more coffee also study longer. Coffee seems to help.
买咖啡多的学生也学得久，咖啡似乎有帮助。
B
Or people studying longer need more coffee to stay awake.
也可能学得久的人更需要咖啡提神。
A
So the direction could be the other way around?
所以方向可能正好反过来？
B
Yes. Exams could also increase both studying and coffee purchases.
对。考试也可能同时增加学习和咖啡购买。
A
We could compare ordinary weeks with exam weeks.
可以比较普通周和考试周。
B
Useful, but ask about sleep too. Shop records will not show that.
有用，但也问睡眠。商店记录不会显示这些。
A
Then our first conclusion should be about a connection, not a cause.
那最初结论应说有关联，不能说是原因。
B
Exactly. A good question is stronger than an unsupported answer.
没错。好问题比没依据的答案更有价值。

dialogues.title: 健身房与健康
dialogues.scene: 朋友讨论会员调查
dialogues.intent: 比较选择效应与活动影响
dialogues.question: 会员更健康还有什么解释？
dialogues.answer: 注重健康的人更可能加入。
dialogues.challenge: 用另一个生活例子解释选择造成的差异。
rows: A
Gym members report better health. Joining must improve your health.
健身房会员报告健康更好，加入肯定改善健康。
B
It may, but health-conscious people might be more likely to join.
可能，但注重健康的人也更可能加入。
A
Could we compare members before and after they join?
能比较会员加入前后吗？
B
That helps, although their diet or work schedule could change too.
有帮助，不过饮食或工作时间也可能改变。
A
We would need a similar group who did not join.
我们需要一组相似但没加入的人。
B
Yes, and still explain what the comparison cannot rule out.
对，也要说明比较仍无法排除什么。
A
So I can say exercise is worth trying without claiming this survey proves it.
所以我能说运动值得尝试，但不说调查证明了效果。
B
That is a much more careful way to describe it.
这样描述谨慎得多。

dialogues.title: 平均快了，谁等得更久
dialogues.scene: 服务中心查看排队报表
dialogues.intent: 从总体指标转向群体差异
dialogues.question: 总体改善隐藏了什么？
dialogues.answer: 复杂申请者等得更久。
dialogues.challenge: 你要选择两个指标检查服务公平，说明理由。
rows: A
Average waiting time fell to twelve minutes. The new system works.
平均等待降到十二分钟，新系统有效了。
B
For simple requests, yes. Complex applications now take much longer.
简单申请是这样，复杂申请却等更久了。
A
How can the overall average fall then?
那总体平均怎么会下降？
B
Most visitors have simple requests, so their improvement dominates the figure.
多数访客办理简单业务，他们的改善主导了数字。
A
We should show the two groups separately.
应该把两组分别展示。
B
And the longest waits. A typical visit does not reveal the worst delays.
还要看最长等待。典型情况看不出最严重延误。
A
Could a specialist handle complex cases without slowing the main queue?
专人处理复杂事项，能不拖慢主队列吗？
B
Let's try it and check that neither group loses out.
试试，并检查两组都没有吃亏。

dialogues.title: 配送承诺十五分钟
dialogues.scene: 餐馆审查送餐时间
dialogues.intent: 辨别典型值与尾部体验
dialogues.question: 为什么顾客仍抱怨？
dialogues.answer: 较远地址在高峰期等待很久。
dialogues.challenge: 为网站写一句准确、不夸大的配送说明。
rows: A
Most orders arrive in fifteen minutes. Why do reviews mention an hour?
多数订单十五分钟送到，评论为什么提一小时？
B
A few distant orders wait much longer during dinner rush.
晚餐高峰少量远处订单等很久。
A
But the median is still fifteen minutes.
但中位数仍是十五分钟。
B
That tells us about the middle order, not every customer's experience.
那反映中间那个订单，不是每位顾客的体验。
A
Should we remove the fifteen-minute promise?
要去掉十五分钟承诺吗？
B
Give estimates by distance and update them when demand rises.
按距离估时，需求上升时更新。
A
And warn customers before payment, rather than afterward.
而且付款前提醒，不是在付款后。
B
Yes. A slower honest estimate is better than a quick broken promise.
对。诚实估慢一点，比承诺很快却做不到好。

dialogues.title: 警报多不等于故障多
dialogues.scene: 运营人员检查设备警报
dialogues.intent: 用实际数量理解误报
dialogues.question: 一百次警报有多少次是真故障？
dialogues.answer: 十次。
dialogues.challenge: 警报很少但漏掉严重故障，说明取舍。
rows: A
The alarm sounds accurate. Should we stop a machine whenever it rings?
警报听着很准，一响就停机器吗？
B
Last month, it flagged a hundred machines. Only ten actually had faults.
上个月它标记一百台，只有十台真有故障。
A
So ninety stops would have been unnecessary?
所以九十次停机会是不必要的？
B
Yes, but ignoring every alarm would miss those ten real faults.
对，但忽略全部警报也会漏掉十台真故障。
A
We need a quick inspection before shutting down.
关闭前需要快速检查。
B
Unless the possible fault is dangerous enough to require immediate action.
除非潜在故障危险到需要立即采取行动。
A
Then the response should depend on the consequence, not just the alert.
那应对要看后果，不只看警报。
B
Exactly. Let's classify alerts by risk and record what inspections find.
没错。按风险分类，并记录检查发现。

dialogues.title: 邮件为什么被拦
dialogues.scene: 同事讨论垃圾邮件过滤
dialogues.intent: 权衡误判与漏判
dialogues.question: 为什么不能只收紧过滤？
dialogues.answer: 会把更多正常邮件也拦住。
dialogues.challenge: 设计一个不会轻易丢失重要邮件的处理流程。
rows: A
An important customer email went into spam. Can you loosen the filter?
重要客户邮件进了垃圾箱，能放宽过滤吗？
B
We can, but more suspicious messages may reach your inbox.
可以，但更多可疑邮件也会进收件箱。
A
I would rather see them than miss an order.
我宁愿看到它们，也不想漏掉订单。
B
That is understandable. Could we highlight uncertain messages instead?
可以理解。能把不确定邮件标出来吗？
A
With a warning and a daily review list?
附上警告和每日检查列表？
B
Yes. Known dangerous attachments would still be blocked.
对。已知危险附件仍会拦截。
A
I'll review the list without opening anything suspicious.
我会查列表，不打开可疑内容。
B
Then we can adjust the rules using the mistakes you report.
之后根据你报告的误判调整规则。

dialogues.title: 多点击算学会了吗
dialogues.scene: 学习网站团队评估页面变化
dialogues.intent: 区分参与指标与实际能力
dialogues.question: 点击增加为何不够？
dialogues.answer: 不能说明用户是否理解并记住内容。
dialogues.challenge: 为对话学习设计一个实际能力检查。
rows: A
The colorful page increased clicks by twenty percent. Let's keep it.
彩色页面点击增加两成，保留它吧。
B
Maybe. Did learners remember more afterward?
也许。学习者之后记住了更多吗？
A
We measured time on the page, not memory.
我们测了停留时间，没测记忆。
B
Longer time could mean interest, or simply confusion.
待得久可能是有兴趣，也可能只是看不懂。
A
Then randomly showing the pages does not answer our main question.
那随机展示页面也回答不了主要问题。
B
It answers the question we measured. We need a learning check too.
它回答了已测的问题。还需要检查学习效果。
A
Let's ask users to understand a new dialogue a week later.
一周后让用户理解一段新对话吧。
B
Good. Keep the test short so we do not drive learners away.
好。检查要短，别把学习者吓跑。

dialogues.title: 会员多了是成功吗
dialogues.scene: 社区图书馆评估宣传
dialogues.intent: 将活动指标联系到使用目标
dialogues.question: 注册增加还需检查什么？
dialogues.answer: 人们是否持续借阅和使用服务。
dialogues.challenge: 新会员不再来，提出不预设原因的调查。
rows: A
Our campaign brought three hundred new members. It was a success.
宣传带来三百名新会员，成功了。
B
Registrations rose, but many have not borrowed anything yet.
注册增加了，但很多人还没借东西。
A
Perhaps they only wanted the free welcome bag.
也许他们只是想要免费欢迎礼包。
B
Perhaps, though opening hours may also be inconvenient.
也许，不过开放时间也可能不方便。
A
We should ask rather than assume their motives.
应当询问，而不是猜他们的动机。
B
And compare repeat visits after the campaign, not just sign-ups.
还要比较宣传后的再次到访，不只看注册。
A
Could we send a short invitation explaining useful services?
可以发简短邀请，介绍实用服务吗？
B
Yes, with an easy way to tell us what they need.
可以，也要让他们方便地告诉我们需求。

dialogues.title: 要准备多少把椅子
dialogues.scene: 组织者讨论户外活动人数
dialogues.intent: 用范围和决策成本安排资源
dialogues.question: 为什么不直接准备预测人数的椅子？
dialogues.answer: 预测有范围，短缺和多备的成本不同。
dialogues.challenge: 突然可能下雨，重新安排并解释选择。
rows: A
You predict two hundred visitors. I'll order two hundred chairs.
你预测两百位访客，我就订两百把椅子。
B
That is the middle estimate. The likely range is much wider.
那是中间估计，可能范围宽得多。
A
How wide are we talking?
宽到什么程度？
B
Roughly one hundred and fifty to three hundred, depending on weather.
大约一百五十到三百，取决于天气。
A
Extra chairs cost little, but running out would be awkward.
多备椅子成本小，不够却很尴尬。
B
Then prepare toward the upper end and keep some folded away.
那按较高人数准备，部分先折叠收好。
A
Food is different. Leftovers would be expensive.
食物不同，剩下会很贵。
B
Order a smaller first batch and arrange a possible refill.
先少订一批，安排必要时补充。

dialogues.title: 旅行预算留多少
dialogues.scene: 朋友规划海岛旅行
dialogues.intent: 为不确定支出设置余量
dialogues.question: 为什么保留备用钱？
dialogues.answer: 航班、天气和交通可能改变支出。
dialogues.challenge: 预算有限，说出你会削减和保留的部分。
rows: A
The estimate says the trip costs eight hundred. That's exactly my budget.
估计旅行要八百，正好是我的预算。
B
Does that include a delayed flight or an extra hotel night?
包括航班延误或多住一晚吗？
A
No. I used the cheapest prices I found.
没有。我用的是找到的最低价格。
B
Then it is one possible plan, not a guaranteed total.
那是一个可能方案，不是保证的总价。
A
I could choose a cheaper hotel and keep some money aside.
可以选便宜些的酒店，留一点钱。
B
Also check which bookings you can change without a large fee.
也查哪些预订更改时不收高额费用。
A
So flexibility has value even when the ticket costs slightly more.
所以即使票稍贵，灵活性也有价值。
B
Exactly. Compare the whole risk, not just today's lowest price.
没错。比较整体风险，不只看今天最低价。

dialogues.title: 被筛掉的好申请者
dialogues.scene: 招聘团队审查自动筛选
dialogues.intent: 提出可检查的公平条件
dialogues.question: 为什么平均准确率不足以决定上线？
dialogues.answer: 不同经历的申请者可能受到不同影响。
dialogues.challenge: 系统省时但漏掉部分人才，提出使用条件。
rows: A
The tool cuts review time in half. I want to use it next month.
工具把审核时间减半，我想下月使用。
B
Before that, we should check which applicants it rejects incorrectly.
此前应检查它错误拒绝了哪些申请者。
A
Its overall accuracy is higher than our old process.
它总体准确率高于旧流程。
B
That could still hide worse results for people with unusual career paths.
仍可能掩盖非典型职业经历者的较差结果。
A
Such as someone returning after caring for a parent?
比如照顾父母后重返职场的人？
B
Exactly. A career gap should not automatically imply weak ability.
对。职业空档不应自动意味着能力弱。
A
Let's sample rejected applications and offer a human review route.
抽查被拒申请，并提供人工复核渠道。
B
And pause the tool if we cannot explain a consistent pattern of errors.
如果一类错误持续出现又无法解释，就暂停工具。

dialogues.title: 谁先获得培训名额
dialogues.scene: 员工讨论培训推荐工具
dialogues.intent: 检验历史数据中的偏差
dialogues.question: 工具为什么可能延续旧差异？
dialogues.answer: 使用曾经不均等的参训记录。
dialogues.challenge: 提出比过去参训次数更合理的选择依据。
rows: A
The recommendation keeps choosing staff who already attended several courses.
推荐总选已经上过几门课的员工。
B
It uses past participation to predict who will complete the training.
它根据过去参与情况预测谁会完成培训。
A
But some workers never had permission to leave their shifts.
但有些员工过去根本获准不了离开岗位。
B
Then low participation may reflect access, rather than lack of interest.
那参与少可能因为机会不足，不是没兴趣。
A
Could we ask about current goals and offer protected training time?
能询问当前目标，并保障培训时间吗？
B
Yes, though places are still limited.
可以，不过名额仍有限。
A
Reserve some places for first-time participants and explain the criteria.
给首次参加者留些名额，并说明标准。
B
Let's review completion later without treating past exclusion as a prediction.
之后再评估完成情况，不把过去缺机会当作预测依据。

dialogues.title: 一次同意包括什么
dialogues.scene: 用户代表审查健康应用授权
dialogues.intent: 区分必要功能与可选共享
dialogues.question: 用户反对什么？
dialogues.answer: 用一个按钮同时同意服务和广告共享。
dialogues.challenge: 公司希望更多人授权，提出诚实设计。
rows: A
One consent button keeps setup simple. Why add several choices?
一个同意按钮让设置简单，为什么加多个选择？
B
Because tracking my steps and sharing my health data are different decisions.
因为记步数和共享健康数据是不同决定。
A
The details are in the privacy notice.
详细内容都在隐私说明里。
B
Few people understand that long document before starting a workout.
开始运动前，没几个人能理解那篇长文。
A
We could show a short explanation beside each option.
可以在每个选项旁放简短解释。
B
And keep optional sharing off until users choose it.
可选共享应先关闭，等用户自己选。
A
Would they still get the basic service if they refuse?
拒绝后仍能获得基础服务吗？
B
They should. Otherwise the choice is difficult to call voluntary.
应该能，否则很难说选择是自愿的。

dialogues.title: 照片能放宣传页吗
dialogues.scene: 活动组织者询问照片使用
dialogues.intent: 明确许可范围和撤回渠道
dialogues.question: 参与者同意了什么范围？
dialogues.answer: 内部纪念册，不含公开广告。
dialogues.challenge: 照片已发布，怎样回应撤回请求？
rows: A
You agreed to photos at the workshop. Can we use one in an advertisement?
你同意活动拍照，能拿一张做广告吗？
B
I agreed to the group album, not public advertising.
我同意的是群内相册，不是公开广告。
A
I thought the original permission covered both.
我以为原来的许可包含两者。
B
The audience and purpose matter. Please ask separately.
受众和用途很重要，请分别征求同意。
A
Of course. Would a picture without your face be acceptable?
当然。不露你脸的照片可以吗？
B
Possibly. Let me see the image and the caption first.
可能。先让我看照片和说明文字。
A
We'll also provide a contact for removal requests.
我们也会提供申请删除的联系方式。
B
Thanks. Clear permission protects trust as well as the event.
谢谢。明确许可既保护信任，也保护活动。

dialogues.title: 这幅图是谁做的
dialogues.scene: 编辑与插画师讨论工具署名
dialogues.intent: 说明创作过程和贡献
dialogues.question: 署名如何反映实际工作？
dialogues.answer: 注明插画师的修改与工具辅助。
dialogues.challenge: 客户要求隐瞒工具使用，说出你的立场与理由。
rows: A
The draft came from a generation tool. Should we credit the tool alone?
初稿来自生成工具，要只给工具署名吗？
B
I changed the composition, redrew the hands, and checked every detail.
我改了构图，重画了手，还检查了全部细节。
A
Then calling it entirely machine-made would hide your contribution.
那说完全由机器制作会掩盖你的贡献。
B
Yes, but claiming I drew every part from scratch would also mislead.
对，但说每部分都从零画也会误导。
A
Could we describe it as your illustration with tool-assisted development?
能写成你的插画，并说明工具辅助制作吗？
B
That sounds accurate, provided we explain the process when asked.
这样准确，别人问时也应说明过程。
A
We also need to check the client's rules before publication.
发布前还需要检查客户规则。
B
Agreed. Transparency does not replace responsibility for the final image.
同意。透明说明不能代替对最终作品负责。

dialogues.title: 团队报告上的名字
dialogues.scene: 同事讨论报告贡献
dialogues.intent: 公平呈现不同贡献
dialogues.question: 只列写作者有什么问题？
dialogues.answer: 忽视收集数据和核查的人。
dialogues.challenge: 有人只参加了一次会议，怎样决定是否署名？
rows: A
I wrote the report, so I planned to put only my name on it.
报告是我写的，所以打算只写我的名字。
B
Lena collected the data, and Omar checked the calculations.
莉娜收集了数据，奥马尔核查了计算。
A
I was thinking about the writing, not the work behind it.
我只想到写作，没想到背后的工作。
B
Readers should know whose expertise supports each part.
读者应该知道每部分由谁的专业工作支持。
A
Then a contribution note may be clearer than a long name list.
那贡献说明可能比长名单更清楚。
B
Yes. Ask everyone whether it describes their role accurately.
对。问问大家是否准确描述了他们的角色。
A
And I will still take responsibility for the final wording.
我仍会对最终措辞负责。
B
That recognizes collaboration without making accountability disappear.
这样承认协作，也不让责任消失。

dialogues.title: 刷脸还是刷卡
dialogues.scene: 学生讨论食堂识别系统
dialogues.intent: 用替代方案检验必要性
dialogues.question: 为什么先考虑刷卡？
dialogues.answer: 能实现主要功能且采集更少个人信息。
dialogues.challenge: 刷卡有人代用，提出适度解决方案。
rows: A
Face recognition would prevent people from sharing meal accounts.
人脸识别能防止人们共用餐费账户。
B
How serious is that problem compared with collecting everyone's face data?
和收集所有人的面部数据相比，问题有多严重？
A
We have a few reported cases, but no reliable total.
有几起报告，但没有可靠总数。
B
Then we should measure the problem before choosing an intrusive solution.
那应该先测问题，再选侵入性方案。
A
Would a card system with occasional checks be enough?
刷卡加偶尔检查够吗？
B
Possibly. It gives us a way to improve security with less data.
可能。它能用更少的数据改善安全。
A
If abuse continues, can we reconsider other options?
如果滥用持续，可以重新考虑其他选择吗？
B
Yes, with clear evidence, retention limits, and an alternative for students.
可以，但要有明确证据、保存期限和学生替代方式。

dialogues.title: 门禁要收指纹吗
dialogues.scene: 住户审查新门禁
dialogues.intent: 衡量便利与隐私成本
dialogues.question: 住户为何要求钥匙选项？
dialogues.answer: 不愿提交生物信息且系统可能失灵。
dialogues.challenge: 物业说大家都已经同意了，解释个体选择的必要。
rows: A
Fingerprint entry is convenient. Nobody will lose a key again.
指纹开门方便，再也没人丢钥匙。
B
What happens when the reader fails or my fingers are injured?
读头失灵或我手指受伤时怎么办？
A
Staff can unlock the door remotely.
工作人员可以远程开门。
B
That is not reliable at midnight. I also prefer not to submit fingerprints.
半夜不可靠。我也不想提交指纹。
A
Would keeping physical keys reduce your concern?
保留实体钥匙能减少你的担心吗？
B
Yes, if both options are equally available without extra charges.
能，前提是两种都能使用，不另外收费。
A
We should ask what data the supplier keeps and for how long.
还应问供应商保留什么数据、保存多久。
B
Exactly. Convenience alone does not answer those questions.
没错。方便本身回答不了这些问题。

dialogues.title: 推荐里只有愤怒
dialogues.scene: 社区主持讨论新闻推荐
dialogues.intent: 连接个人选择与平台激励
dialogues.question: 推荐为什么可能越变越窄？
dialogues.answer: 点击强烈情绪内容会触发更多类似推荐。
dialogues.challenge: 提出既尊重选择又减少单一信息的方法。
rows: A
Users choose what to click. Why blame the recommendation system?
用户自己选择点击，为什么责怪推荐系统？
B
Because one angry click can lead to a feed full of similar stories.
因为一次愤怒的点击可能带来整屏同类故事。
A
The system is responding to what seems relevant to them.
系统在回应看似与他们相关的内容。
B
Relevant is not always useful, especially when outrage keeps people scrolling.
相关不总是有用，尤其愤怒让人不停刷时。
A
Would showing more varied sources help?
展示更多不同来源有帮助吗？
B
Yes, if users can understand and control why stories appear.
有，如果用户能理解并控制出现原因。
A
We could test satisfaction after reading, not just immediate clicks.
可以测试阅读后的满意度，不只看即时点击。
B
And check whether the change improves discussion, rather than just screen time.
也检查是否改善讨论，不只增加屏幕时间。

dialogues.title: 购物推荐只推贵的
dialogues.scene: 顾客与产品人员交流
dialogues.intent: 识别推荐目标与用户目标差距
dialogues.question: 顾客希望推荐考虑什么？
dialogues.answer: 预算、实际需要和购买后的满意度。
dialogues.challenge: 平台靠佣金赚钱，提出可接受的透明规则。
rows: A
Your recommendations keep showing expensive products I do not need.
你们总推荐我不需要的昂贵商品。
B
You recently viewed several premium models.
你最近看过几款高端型号。
A
I was comparing them, not asking to be pushed toward buying one.
我在比较，不是要求被推着买。
B
Could a budget setting make the recommendations more useful?
预算设置能让推荐更有用吗？
A
Yes, and show when a seller pays for the placement.
能，也要标明卖家付费展示的内容。
B
We already label sponsored items, though the label could be clearer.
我们已标赞助内容，不过标识可以更清楚。
A
Then ask whether purchases met my needs, not just whether I clicked.
还要问购买是否满足需要，不只问有没有点击。
B
That would give us a better measure of a useful recommendation.
那能更好衡量推荐是否有用。

dialogues.title: 免费但等很久的公交
dialogues.scene: 居民预算听证会
dialogues.intent: 比较降价与改善服务的机会成本
dialogues.question: 为什么先改善班次？
dialogues.answer: 票价不是所有人不坐公交的主要原因。
dialogues.challenge: 低收入乘客很在意票价，提出兼顾方案。
rows: A
Free buses would help everyone. Why not fund them first?
免费公交帮助所有人，为什么不先资助它？
B
Because the same budget could double evening services instead.
因为同样预算可以把晚间班次翻倍。
A
But removing fares would encourage more people to travel.
但取消票价能鼓励更多人乘车。
B
Not someone who waits forty minutes after a late shift.
对下晚班要等四十分钟的人不一定。
A
So we need to know whether cost or frequency is the bigger barrier.
所以要知道票价还是班次是更大障碍。
B
Exactly. And different passengers may need different support.
对，不同乘客需要的支持可能不同。
A
What about targeted fare discounts plus more evening buses?
定向票价优惠加更多晚班车怎么样？
B
Let's cost that option and show what spending it would replace.
我们算算费用，也展示它会替代哪些支出。

dialogues.title: 社区资金只能用一次
dialogues.scene: 居民选择公共设施
dialogues.intent: 说明取舍而非只赞成目标
dialogues.question: 为什么要考虑后续费用？
dialogues.answer: 建成后仍要维护和运营。
dialogues.challenge: 支持另一方案时，公平复述对方需求。
rows: A
The grant could build a playground or renovate the meeting room.
补助可以建游乐场，也可以翻修会议室。
B
Both sound useful. Could we split the money?
都不错，可以把钱分开吗？
A
Then neither project would be safe or complete.
那两项都可能不安全或不完整。
B
We should compare who uses each and what alternatives exist.
应比较使用人群和现有替代设施。
A
Children have no nearby play area; meetings can use the school temporarily.
孩子附近没地方玩，会议能暂时借学校。
B
That favors the playground, but who pays for repairs later?
这支持建游乐场，但以后谁付维修费？
A
We need an ongoing budget before deciding.
决定前需要持续预算。
B
Agreed. A grant pays for construction, not necessarily a lasting service.
同意。补助负责建设，不一定能保障长期服务。

dialogues.title: 游客花的钱留在哪
dialogues.scene: 海边商户讨论旅游限制
dialogues.intent: 比较地方收益与外部成本
dialogues.question: 营业额为什么不能代表全部收益？
dialogues.answer: 部分收入外流，居民承担租金和交通压力。
dialogues.challenge: 提出不简单禁止游客的限制办法。
rows: A
Visitor numbers are up. Limiting them would hurt our shops.
游客数量涨了，限制会伤害我们商店。
B
I understand, but rents and traffic have risen too.
我理解，但租金和交通压力也上升了。
A
At least tourism brings money into town.
至少旅游给镇上带来钱。
B
Some stays here; some goes to outside booking companies and hotel owners.
部分留在这里，部分流向外地订房公司和酒店业主。
A
Then we should encourage locally owned businesses rather than cut everyone off.
那应鼓励本地企业，不是一概阻断游客。
B
And manage peak arrivals, where the pressure is greatest.
也要管理高峰到访，那里压力最大。
A
Could we test daily booking limits only on busy summer weekends?
能只在夏季繁忙周末试每日预约限额吗？
B
Yes, while tracking local sales, housing costs, and residents' experience.
可以，同时追踪本地销售、住房费用和居民感受。

dialogues.title: 音乐节带来的夜晚
dialogues.scene: 商家和居民协调音乐节
dialogues.intent: 协商受益者承担相关成本
dialogues.question: 双方达成什么条件？
dialogues.answer: 限制结束时间，经营者分担清洁和交通成本。
dialogues.challenge: 有店主不愿分担，说服他参与。
rows: A
The festival brings our best sales all year.
音乐节带来我们全年最好的销售。
B
It also leaves rubbish outside homes and noise after midnight.
也在住家外留下垃圾，半夜仍有噪音。
A
We cannot control every visitor once they leave the venue.
游客离开场地后，我们无法控制每个人。
B
True, but businesses benefit and can help manage the consequences.
是，但商家受益，也能帮助处理后果。
A
Would an earlier finish and extra bins be enough?
提前结束、多放垃圾桶够吗？
B
Add late transport, so crowds do not linger in residential streets.
加晚间交通，免得人群停留在住宅街道。
A
We could contribute through a shared festival fund.
我们可以通过共同节庆基金出资。
B
Then review complaints and costs before repeating the event.
之后审查投诉和成本，再决定是否续办。

dialogues.title: 机器到了，人怎么办
dialogues.scene: 仓库讨论自动化转型
dialogues.intent: 把转型收益与短期成本分开
dialogues.question: 培训承诺还缺什么？
dialogues.answer: 有薪学习时间和明确岗位。
dialogues.challenge: 新岗位比原来少，提出公正过渡安排。
rows: A
Automation will make the warehouse more productive. We will offer retraining.
自动化会提高仓库生产率，我们会提供再培训。
B
During paid hours, or after workers finish their shifts?
是在带薪时间，还是员工下班后？
A
The initial plan puts courses in the evening.
初步计划把课程放在晚上。
B
Then workers pay the transition cost with their own time.
那员工用自己的时间承担转型成本。
A
We could schedule paid sessions, though that slows the rollout.
可以安排带薪课程，但会拖慢实施。
B
A slower rollout may prevent people losing income before they qualify.
慢一点可能防止员工取得资格前就失去收入。
A
Let's list the new roles and guarantee training before any transfer.
列出新岗位，并保证调岗前接受培训。
B
And discuss workers who cannot move into those roles, not just success stories.
也讨论无法转入新岗位的人，不只讲成功案例。

dialogues.title: 自助结账后的工作
dialogues.scene: 超市讨论员工岗位变化
dialogues.intent: 检验岗位转型是否真实可行
dialogues.question: 为什么不能只说员工去服务顾客？
dialogues.answer: 需要具体工时、薪资和职责。
dialogues.challenge: 员工担心降薪，代表双方提出书面约定。
rows: A
Self-checkouts free staff to help customers on the floor.
自助结账让员工能到卖场帮助顾客。
B
Will those roles offer the same hours and pay?
那些岗位有相同工时和工资吗？
A
We have not finalized the schedules yet.
排班还没定下来。
B
Then calling it an opportunity is a little early.
那现在说是机会有点早。
A
Fair point. What would make the change workable for you?
有道理。怎样改才能让你接受？
B
Clear duties, training, and no sudden cut in contracted hours.
明确职责、提供培训、不突然削减合同工时。
A
We can trial the arrangement in one store first.
可以先在一家店试行。
B
And use staff feedback to decide what changes before expansion.
扩展前根据员工反馈决定改什么。

dialogues.title: 学校午餐买谁的菜
dialogues.scene: 项目人员讨论本地采购
dialogues.intent: 比较价格、韧性与稳定供给
dialogues.question: 为什么不全部选择最低价供应商？
dialogues.answer: 单一远方供应可能中断，且忽视本地收益。
dialogues.challenge: 本地供应商歉收，提出备用采购方案。
rows: A
Local vegetables cost more. We could feed more children with the cheaper supplier.
本地蔬菜更贵，便宜供应商能让更多孩子吃上饭。
B
Yes, but relying on one distant source risks delivery failures.
对，但依赖一个远方来源有配送中断风险。
A
Local farms cannot supply everything throughout the year.
本地农场也不能全年供应所有东西。
B
Then a mixed contract may be safer than choosing only one side.
那混合合同可能比只选一方安全。
A
Could we use seasonal local produce and keep a backup supplier?
能用本地应季蔬菜，并保留备用供应商吗？
B
Yes, with clear quality standards for both.
能，两方都要有明确质量标准。
A
We must also tell farmers our expected demand early.
也要提前告诉农民预计需求。
B
That helps them plan without promising purchases we cannot afford.
能帮助他们规划，也不承诺我们负担不起的采购。

dialogues.title: 医院备用物资
dialogues.scene: 医院采购团队讨论供应
dialogues.intent: 把可靠性纳入价格比较
dialogues.question: 低价订单的隐藏风险是什么？
dialogues.answer: 延迟可能迫使医院紧急高价采购。
dialogues.challenge: 库存占空间，提出合理的备用原则。
rows: A
The overseas order is much cheaper than the nearby supplier.
海外订单比附近供应商便宜得多。
B
Does the comparison include what happens if shipping is delayed?
比较包括运输延误后会怎样吗？
A
No. Delivery has usually been reliable.
没有。配送通常很可靠。
B
Usually matters less when a missing item stops patient care.
缺一件就影响治疗时，通常可靠还不够。
A
We could keep emergency stock and a smaller local contract.
可以留应急库存和一份较小的本地合同。
B
Exactly. Not every item needs the same backup level.
对。不是每件物品都需要同样备用量。
A
Let's rank items by urgency, storage life, and replacement options.
按紧迫程度、保质期和替代选择分类吧。
B
Then price becomes one part of the decision, rather than the whole decision.
那价格成为决定的一部分，而不是全部。

dialogues.title: 收入涨了就进步了吗
dialogues.scene: 研究员准备城市年报
dialogues.intent: 避免单一平均指标代表整体进步
dialogues.question: 年报需要补什么？
dialogues.answer: 分组收入、住房负担和健康等指标。
dialogues.challenge: 只允许首页放三个指标，说明你的选择。
rows: A
Average income rose, so the report calls this a successful year.
平均收入上涨，报告因此称这是成功的一年。
B
What happened to households at the lower end?
低收入家庭的情况怎样？
A
Their incomes changed little, while rent increased.
他们收入变化很小，租金却涨了。
B
Then the average may hide a decline in everyday affordability.
那平均数可能掩盖日常负担能力下降。
A
We should add housing costs and income groups.
应加上住房费用和不同收入群体。
B
And measures beyond money, such as health and travel time.
还有金钱以外的指标，比如健康和出行时间。
A
Would one combined score make the report easier to read?
合成一个分数会让报告更易读吗？
B
Perhaps, but show the components so readers can see the trade-offs.
也许，但要展示各部分，让读者看清取舍。

dialogues.title: 公司增长后的疲惫
dialogues.scene: 同事评价公司年度成绩
dialogues.intent: 将增长与工作质量一起评估
dialogues.question: 销售增长为何不代表人人受益？
dialogues.answer: 加班增加而薪资和工作条件未改善。
dialogues.challenge: 向老板提出两项具体改善及衡量方式。
rows: A
Sales grew by a third. The team should feel proud.
销售增长三分之一，团队应该自豪。
B
We are proud, but overtime also increased sharply.
我们自豪，但加班也大幅增加了。
A
Growth often brings a busy period before things settle.
增长往往先带来繁忙期，之后才稳定。
B
This has lasted nine months. It may be the new normal.
已经持续九个月，可能成了常态。
A
Then we need to look at staffing and workload, not just revenue.
那要看人员和工作量，不只看收入。
B
And whether wages and recovery time improved with the extra work.
也看更多工作是否带来工资和休息改善。
A
I'll include those figures in the next management review.
我会把这些数据放进下次管理评估。
B
Thanks. A stronger business should support the people making it stronger.
谢谢。企业更强也应支持让它变强的人。

dialogues.title: 满意的人为什么都来了
dialogues.scene: 学生核查图书馆问卷
dialogues.intent: 识别没有回应的人
dialogues.question: 门口调查漏掉什么人？
dialogues.answer: 已经不来或不便使用图书馆的人。
dialogues.challenge: 改进调查而不要求所有人必须回应。
rows: A
Ninety percent of respondents like the library. That is reassuring.
九成回答者喜欢图书馆，令人安心。
B
Where did you invite people to answer?
你在哪里邀请大家回答？
A
At the entrance, during weekday mornings.
入口处，工作日上午。
B
Then people who work those hours or stopped visiting are missing.
那上班的人和已经不来的人都没被问到。
A
We cannot simply assume they would answer the same way.
不能直接假设他们也会这样回答。
B
Exactly. Try evening visitors and community contacts outside the building.
对。问晚间访客，也通过楼外社区渠道联系。
A
Should I replace the first results when new responses arrive?
新回答来了，要替换最初结果吗？
B
Show both, explain the limits, and check which groups remain unheard.
两组都展示，解释限制，检查还有哪些人没发声。

dialogues.title: 外卖评价漏掉的人
dialogues.scene: 餐馆讨论顾客满意度
dialogues.intent: 核查自愿评价的代表性
dialogues.question: 五星评价不能说明什么？
dialogues.answer: 不能说明所有顾客都满意。
dialogues.challenge: 提出一种不会逼迫好评的反馈邀请。
rows: A
Nearly all our reviews are five stars. Customers must be happy.
评价几乎都是五星，顾客一定很满意。
B
Happy customers often respond to the review invitation. Others may just leave.
满意顾客常响应评价邀请，别人可能直接离开。
A
But angry people also write reviews.
但生气的人也会写评论。
B
True. Both strong reactions may be more visible than ordinary experiences.
是，两种强烈反应可能都比普通体验更显眼。
A
Could we send a short feedback link to a random set of orders?
能随机抽一些订单发简短反馈链接吗？
B
Yes, without offering a reward only for positive comments.
能，不要只给好评奖励。
A
And count how many invited customers actually reply.
还要记录邀请的人里有多少真回答。
B
That will help us describe the results more honestly.
这样能更诚实地描述结果。

dialogues.title: 少上一天班后的变化
dialogues.scene: 团队评估四天工作周
dialogues.intent: 区分政策效果和其他变化
dialogues.question: 产出增加还有什么解释？
dialogues.answer: 新软件和新增员工同时上线。
dialogues.challenge: 提出一组更合理的比较对象。
rows: A
Output rose after the four-day trial. We should expand it immediately.
四天工作试点后产出增加，应立即推广。
B
We also hired two staff and introduced new software that month.
那个月也招了两人、换了新软件。
A
So the shorter week may not explain the increase by itself.
所以短工作周可能不能单独解释增长。
B
Right. What happened in similar teams without the trial?
对。没试点的相似团队怎样了？
A
Their output rose too, though we have not compared workloads.
他们产出也涨了，不过还没比较工作量。
B
Let's compare similar tasks and ask about fatigue, not only output.
比较相似任务，也问疲劳，不只看产出。
A
Could we extend the trial while collecting that evidence?
能边收证据边延长试点吗？
B
Yes, with a review date and no promise that the result is already settled.
可以，定评估日期，不声称结果已确定。

dialogues.title: 新店长来了以后
dialogues.scene: 同事讨论门店销售增长
dialogues.intent: 避免把同时发生当作因果
dialogues.question: 为什么不能全归功于店长？
dialogues.answer: 同期街区客流也增加。
dialogues.challenge: 既认可店长贡献又保留判断，给出回应。
rows: A
Sales jumped when Maya became manager. She clearly changed everything.
玛雅当店长后销售猛涨，显然全靠她。
B
She improved the displays, but the street also gained a new station.
她改善了陈列，但街上也新开了车站。
A
Then more shoppers may have arrived regardless of her changes.
那不管她怎么改，顾客可能都会增多。
B
Exactly. Compare visitor numbers and the share who actually bought something.
对。比较到访人数和真正购买的比例。
A
If purchases per visitor increased, that would support her contribution.
如果每位访客的购买增加，会支持她的贡献。
B
Yes, though prices and stock availability matter as well.
对，不过价格和库存也重要。
A
I'll praise the specific improvements without attributing every sale to her.
我会赞扬具体改善，不把每笔销售都归功于她。
B
That is fairer to her and more useful for the other stores.
这样对她更公平，对其他门店也更有用。

dialogues.title: 没看准不等于没效果
dialogues.scene: 项目主管查看学习研究
dialogues.intent: 表达估计的不确定性
dialogues.question: 结果不确定等于方法无效吗？
dialogues.answer: 不等于，样本不足以区分几种可能。
dialogues.challenge: 向没有统计背景的朋友解释这个结果。
rows: A
The average improvement is small, but the estimate is quite uncertain.
平均改善很小，但估计很不确定。
B
Can we write that the method does not work?
可以写这个方法无效吗？
A
No. With twelve learners, we cannot distinguish several plausible effects.
不能。只有十二位学习者，分不清几种可能效果。
B
Then what have we learned?
那我们学到了什么？
A
The sessions are workable, and we know how to measure progress better.
课程能执行，也知道怎样更好测进步。
B
Would a larger study give a clearer answer?
更大研究会有更清楚的答案吗？
A
Usually more precise, if we also improve consistency and follow-up.
通常会更精确，前提是也改善一致性和后续追踪。
B
Let's call this an initial estimate and explain what remains unresolved.
那称为初步估计，并解释哪些问题未解决。

dialogues.title: 小店试卖的三天
dialogues.scene: 经营者决定是否保留新品
dialogues.intent: 在有限证据下作可调整决定
dialogues.question: 为什么不立即砍掉新品？
dialogues.answer: 试卖短且遇到特殊天气。
dialogues.challenge: 库存快到期，提出有限风险的下一步。
rows: A
Only six people bought the new drink. Let's remove it.
只有六人买新品饮料，撤掉吧。
B
We tried it for three rainy days. That is a narrow sample.
只试了三个雨天，样本很有限。
A
We cannot keep buying ingredients forever while waiting for certainty.
不能为了等确定答案一直买食材。
B
Agreed. Could we run a smaller batch on a normal weekend?
同意。能在普通周末少量再试一次吗？
A
And set a limit on what we are prepared to lose?
再给愿意承担的损失设上限？
B
Yes. Ask tasters what they liked, even if they did not purchase.
对。也问试喝者喜欢什么，即使没买。
A
Then we have a practical next step, not a claim that demand is zero.
那有实际下一步，不是声称需求为零。
B
Exactly. We can act cautiously without pretending the evidence is complete.
没错。可以谨慎行动，不装作证据完整。

dialogues.title: 别人能看懂我们怎么做吗
dialogues.scene: 研究团队准备公开材料
dialogues.intent: 说明透明材料和探索边界
dialogues.question: 为什么保留不支持结论的结果？
dialogues.answer: 避免让读者误以为所有检查都一致。
dialogues.challenge: 某个结果只是后来发现的，如何诚实介绍？
rows: A
I'll share the successful result and remove the tests that found nothing.
我分享成功结果，删掉没发现效果的测试。
B
Then readers may think every test supported our explanation.
那读者可能以为每个测试都支持解释。
A
The extra tests were exploratory, not part of our original plan.
额外测试是探索性的，不在原计划里。
B
That is fine. Label them as exploratory rather than hiding them.
没关系。标明探索性质，不要隐藏。
A
Should we publish the instructions and analysis steps too?
也要公开说明和分析步骤吗？
B
Yes, so another team can understand and repeat the process.
要，让其他团队能理解并重复过程。
A
We must remove names and check permission before sharing records.
共享记录前必须删除姓名并检查许可。
B
Exactly. Openness should make the work inspectable without exposing participants.
对。公开要让工作可核查，同时不暴露参与者。

dialogues.title: 交接一本真正有用的手册
dialogues.scene: 同事准备活动交接
dialogues.intent: 使工作方法可重做
dialogues.question: 交接为何需要失败记录？
dialogues.answer: 让接任者知道方法条件和常见问题。
dialogues.challenge: 把一次失败经验改成可操作的提醒。
rows: A
Here is the final schedule. You can copy it next year.
这是最终日程，明年可以照着做。
B
Could you include why the earlier schedules changed?
能写上之前日程为什么改吗？
A
They were failures. I did not think you needed them.
它们失败了，我以为你不需要。
B
I do. Otherwise I may repeat the same mistakes.
需要，不然我可能重犯同样错误。
A
The outdoor session failed because the backup room was not reserved.
户外活动失败，因为没有预订备用房间。
B
That is useful. Add a checklist and the contact who handles bookings.
很有用。加个清单和负责预订的联系人。
A
I'll also mark which decisions depended on that year's attendance.
我也会标出哪些决定取决于当年人数。
B
Then I can adapt the process instead of copying it blindly.
那我能调整流程，不是盲目照搬。

dialogues.title: 新闻里的确定语气
dialogues.scene: 编辑修订科学报道
dialogues.intent: 准确压缩研究结论
dialogues.question: 为什么删去“证明”？
dialogues.answer: 观察研究只能发现关联。
dialogues.challenge: 把一个夸大标题改成仍有吸引力的标题。
rows: A
Your headline says gardening prevents loneliness. Did the study establish that?
标题说园艺预防孤独，研究确定了吗？
B
Gardeners reported less loneliness than non-gardeners.
园艺者报告的孤独感低于非园艺者。
A
That is an association. Sociable people may be more likely to join gardens.
那是关联，爱社交的人也可能更愿加入菜园。
B
So 'linked with lower loneliness' would be more accurate.
所以“与较低孤独感有关”更准确。
A
Yes. Also say who took part and how loneliness was measured.
对，也说谁参加了、如何测孤独感。
B
The details could make the story feel less dramatic.
这些细节可能让报道没那么轰动。
A
They make it useful. Readers need to know what the finding means for them.
它们让报道有用。读者要知道发现对自己意味着什么。
B
I'll keep the human story and narrow the scientific claim.
我会保留人物故事，收窄科学结论。

dialogues.title: 群里转发的神奇方法
dialogues.scene: 朋友核查网传学习建议
dialogues.intent: 区分来源与转述
dialogues.question: 转发文字遗漏了什么？
dialogues.answer: 小规模研究的对象和比较条件。
dialogues.challenge: 向群友提醒限制，避免居高临下。
rows: A
This post says ten minutes a day guarantees fluent speech.
帖子说每天十分钟保证说得流利。
B
Does it link to the study, or just mention researchers?
它链接研究了吗，还是只提研究人员？
A
There is a link, but the original says participants improved on a short task.
有链接，但原文说参加者在短任务上进步了。
B
That is much narrower than becoming fluent in everyday life.
那比在日常生活中变流利范围小得多。
A
The routine could still be useful, though.
不过这个习惯可能仍有用。
B
Sure. We can try it without accepting the guarantee.
当然。可以试试，不接受那个保证。
A
I'll share the source and explain the difference politely.
我会分享来源，并礼貌说明区别。
B
Good. Correcting the claim does not require dismissing everyone's interest.
好。纠正说法不需要否定大家的兴趣。

dialogues.title: 高温来之前先做什么
dialogues.scene: 社区讨论降温预算
dialogues.intent: 协调紧急保护与长期适应
dialogues.question: 为什么不能只种树？
dialogues.answer: 树长成需要时间，近期仍需降温空间。
dialogues.challenge: 制冷中心使用少，提出不预设原因的改进。
rows: A
Tree planting will cool the streets. I would put most funding there.
种树会让街道凉快，我想把多数资金放这里。
B
Trees take years to grow. What protects older residents this summer?
树要几年长大，今年夏天怎么保护老年居民？
A
We could open cooling centers during heat warnings.
可以在高温预警时开放降温中心。
B
They need accessible transport and hours that cover the hottest evenings.
还需要方便交通，并覆盖最热的晚间。
A
Then emergency support will reduce the planting budget.
那紧急支持会减少植树预算。
B
Yes, but preventing immediate harm should not wait for a long-term benefit.
对，但预防眼前伤害不能等长期收益。
A
Let's protect the most exposed blocks now and phase in the trees.
先保护暴露最严重的街区，分阶段种树。
B
With maintenance funding too. Dead trees do not provide lasting shade.
也要有维护资金，死树不能提供长期树荫。

dialogues.title: 热浪中的工作安排
dialogues.scene: 工地协调高温作业
dialogues.intent: 协商安全与工期
dialogues.question: 早开工为何还要征求意见？
dialogues.answer: 可能影响通勤和照护安排。
dialogues.challenge: 项目不能全停，提出具体风险降低措施。
rows: A
We could start at five to avoid the afternoon heat.
可以五点开工，避开下午高温。
B
That helps, but some workers have no bus at that hour.
有帮助，但那时有些工人没公交。
A
Could shared transport solve that?
共同交通能解决吗？
B
Partly. We also need shaded breaks, water, and a clear stop-work rule.
部分能。也需要阴凉休息、水和明确停工规则。
A
Stopping work will affect the deadline.
停工会影响截止时间。
B
Heat illness affects people, and it can disrupt the project even more.
热病伤害人，也可能更严重地打乱项目。
A
I'll revise the schedule and agree on warning signs with the safety team.
我会调整日程，并与安全团队商定警示条件。
B
And ensure workers can report symptoms without losing pay for speaking up.
也要确保工人报告症状不会因此损失工资。

dialogues.title: 上下游都在等雨
dialogues.scene: 上下游代表协商枯水用水
dialogues.intent: 建立可核查的合作
dialogues.question: 为什么需要共享测量？
dialogues.answer: 双方才能确认水量和履约情况。
dialogues.challenge: 水量比预期少一半，重谈而不甩锅。
rows: A
Our farms need more water this month. We cannot promise last year's release.
我们农场本月需更多水，无法承诺去年的放水量。
B
Our drinking supply depends on that release. We need a minimum guarantee.
我们的饮水依赖放水，需要最低保障。
A
A fixed number may be impossible if rainfall falls further.
如果降雨再少，固定数字可能做不到。
B
Then agree on shares after essential drinking needs are protected.
那先保障基本饮水，再商定比例。
A
Both sides would need the same measurements to trust the calculation.
双方需要相同测量才能信任计算。
B
Let's share daily readings and allow joint checks at the measuring points.
共享每日读数，允许共同检查测量点。
A
And review allocations when levels cross an agreed threshold.
水位越过约定阈值时重新审查分配。
B
Yes, with notice before changes, not after our pumps run dry.
对，要变更前通知，不是等我们的水泵没水。

dialogues.title: 两家共用一条路
dialogues.scene: 邻居协商施工通道
dialogues.intent: 设计互惠和可验证承诺
dialogues.question: 如何确保双方都能通行？
dialogues.answer: 预约大车时间，保留通道并记录安排。
dialogues.challenge: 一方临时违约，提出修复合作的回应。
rows: A
My builders need the shared road for deliveries all week.
我的工人整周都要用共用道路送货。
B
My guests also need access. You cannot block it without warning.
我的客人也要通行，你不能不通知就封路。
A
Could you give me your busiest arrival times?
能告诉我你最忙的到达时间吗？
B
Yes, if you send a delivery schedule and keep emergency access clear.
可以，但你要发送货日程，并留紧急通道。
A
Heavy trucks could come in the quieter morning period.
大车可以在上午较空闲时来。
B
And any change needs a message before the truck arrives.
任何改动都要在车来之前发消息。
A
I'll put the arrangement in writing and share the builder's number.
我会书面记录安排，并给你工人电话。
B
Then we have something concrete to rely on, not just goodwill.
那我们有具体依据，不只靠好意。

dialogues.title: 经验为什么不算经验
dialogues.scene: 雇主讨论新移民技能认可
dialogues.intent: 识别制度障碍并避免概括
dialogues.question: 证书不足是否等于能力不足？
dialogues.answer: 不等于，可以通过实际能力评估。
dialogues.challenge: 工作需要安全资格，提出合规的过渡办法。
rows: A
Many applicants have foreign qualifications that we cannot easily verify.
很多申请者的海外资格我们不容易核实。
B
That is a verification problem, not evidence that they lack skill.
那是核实问题，不是缺乏技能的证据。
A
We still need confidence before giving them technical work.
让他们做技术工作前仍需要信心。
B
Could a practical assessment show what each person can do?
实际考核能展示每个人能做什么吗？
A
For some tasks, yes. Others legally require a local license.
有些任务可以，另一些依法要求本地执照。
B
Then offer supervised roles while they complete the licensing process.
那在取得执照期间提供有监督的岗位。
A
We would need clear training costs and responsibilities.
需要明确培训费用和责任。
B
Agreed. Assess individuals rather than making assumptions about an entire group.
同意。评估个人，不要对整个群体做假设。

dialogues.title: 换行业后如何证明自己
dialogues.scene: 求职者与招聘人员交流
dialogues.intent: 把经历转成可核实能力
dialogues.question: 求职者怎样说明可迁移技能？
dialogues.answer: 用协调和处理问题的具体经历。
dialogues.challenge: 不用原职位名称，介绍你的一项能力及证据。
rows: A
My experience is in restaurants, but I want to work in customer support.
我的经验在餐馆，但想做客户支持。
B
What part of that experience would transfer to this role?
哪些经验能迁移到这个岗位？
A
I handled complaints and coordinated quick solutions during busy shifts.
忙碌班次里我处理投诉，并协调快速解决。
B
Can you give an example where the first solution failed?
能举个第一次解决办法失败的例子吗？
A
A replacement meal was still unsuitable, so I asked about the guest's actual needs.
换餐仍不合适，我就询问客人的实际需求。
B
That shows more than simply following a script.
那比单纯照话术更能说明能力。
A
I would still need training in your software and service rules.
我仍需要学习你们的软件和服务规则。
B
Recognizing what you know and what you must learn is a useful start.
知道自己会什么、还需学什么，是很好的开始。

dialogues.title: 低价订单背后的加班
dialogues.scene: 买手与审查员讨论工厂订单
dialogues.intent: 把采购激励纳入责任
dialogues.question: 为什么只要求工厂改进不够？
dialogues.answer: 买方压价和急单也推动超时劳动。
dialogues.challenge: 客户要求原价更快交货，说明合理边界。
rows: A
The factory must stop excessive overtime. We should warn them.
工厂必须停止过度加班，应该警告他们。
B
Yes, but we cut the price and shortened the deadline last month.
对，但我们上月压价，还缩短了期限。
A
They accepted the contract. Isn't delivery their responsibility?
他们接受合同，交货不是他们的责任吗？
B
It is, yet our purchasing pressure contributes to the conditions we criticize.
是，但采购压力也促成了我们批评的状况。
A
Then we need a realistic schedule as well as labor checks.
那除了劳动审查，还需要合理日程。
B
And prices that cover safe production, with worker input on improvements.
价格要覆盖安全生产，改善也需听取工人意见。
A
Could we phase the order rather than demand everything at once?
能分批订单，不要求一次完成全部吗？
B
Yes. Share the cost of change instead of pushing it entirely onto the factory.
可以。共同承担改变成本，不全推给工厂。

dialogues.title: 婚礼花束的急单
dialogues.scene: 花店和批发商商量采购
dialogues.intent: 协调截止期、质量与风险
dialogues.question: 为什么不保证原定花材？
dialogues.answer: 临时数量增加，强求会增加浪费和运输风险。
dialogues.challenge: 客户不接受替代，提出诚实且可执行的选择。
rows: A
The client doubled the order, but the wedding date cannot move.
客户把订单翻倍，但婚礼日期不能改。
B
We cannot guarantee that many of the original flowers safely.
我们无法保证安全提供那么多原定花材。
A
Could you rush them from another region?
能从另一个地区急运吗？
B
Possible, but expensive, with a higher chance of damage in transit.
可能，但贵，运输损坏概率也高。
A
I should explain those risks instead of promising the impossible.
我应解释风险，不承诺做不到的事。
B
Offer local alternatives in similar colors and a clear price difference.
提供相似颜色的本地替代花材，并说明价差。
A
Could you send photographs today so the client can choose?
今天能发照片让客户选吗？
B
Yes. A timely choice gives everyone a better chance of delivering well.
能。及时选择让各方更有机会做好交付。

dialogues.title: 大家都想要，谁先付钱
dialogues.scene: 研究联盟讨论共享监测网
dialogues.intent: 降低合作启动的不确定性
dialogues.question: 成员为什么不愿先投入？
dialogues.answer: 担心他人不投入，自己承担全部成本。
dialogues.challenge: 新成员资金少，提出公平参与方式。
rows: A
Every team wants shared monitoring, yet nobody commits funding first.
每队都想共享监测，却没人先承诺资金。
B
We worry about paying while others wait for free access.
我们怕自己付钱，别人等着免费使用。
A
Could contributions begin only when a minimum number of teams sign?
能等最低数量的团队签署后才开始出资吗？
B
That reduces the risk. We also need clear rules for data access.
那减少风险。还需要明确数据使用规则。
A
Members could contribute staff time or equipment, not only cash.
成员可贡献工时或设备，不只现金。
B
If those contributions are valued transparently, smaller teams can join too.
贡献估值透明的话，小团队也能加入。
A
Let's start with one site and publish maintenance responsibilities.
先从一个站点开始，并公开维护责任。
B
A small working agreement may build more trust than a grand promise.
小而有效的协议可能比宏大承诺更能建立信任。

dialogues.title: 邻里工具库如何开始
dialogues.scene: 居民筹建共享工具库
dialogues.intent: 设计可信的共用规则
dialogues.question: 担心借出不归还怎样解决？
dialogues.answer: 先小范围试行，登记借用和维修责任。
dialogues.challenge: 工具坏了但原因不清，提出公平处理流程。
rows: A
Everyone likes the tool library, but nobody wants to lend their drill first.
大家喜欢工具库，却没人愿先借出电钻。
B
People worry it will come back broken, or not come back at all.
人们担心还回来坏了，甚至不归还。
A
A sign-out record and return deadline might help.
借用记录和归还期限可能有帮助。
B
We also need a repair fund, rather than blaming whoever borrowed last.
也要维修基金，不能只怪最后借的人。
A
Could ten households test the system with inexpensive tools?
能让十户用不贵的工具试行吗？
B
Yes. Check condition before and after each loan.
能。每次借用前后检查状态。
A
Then we can improve the rules before asking for costly equipment.
那征集昂贵设备前可以先完善规则。
B
Exactly. Trust grows when people can see how problems are handled.
没错。大家看见问题怎样处理，信任才会增加。

dialogues.title: 你说的安静是什么
dialogues.scene: 新朋友聊工作日和住所
dialogues.intent: 用原因和细节展开熟悉话题
dialogues.question: 居民怎样区分安静和方便？
dialogues.answer: 住所远离车流但仍靠近日常设施。
dialogues.challenge: 不看台词介绍自己的工作日，补一个具体例子和例外。
rows: A
You said your neighborhood suits your routine. What makes it different?
你说这个街区适合你的生活，它有什么不同？
B
It is quiet without being isolated. I can walk to the bakery and station, but my bedroom faces a small courtyard rather than the main road.
它安静却不偏僻。我能步行去面包店和车站，卧室朝小院而不是大路。
A
Does that change how you spend your mornings?
这会改变你早晨的安排吗？
B
Yes. I leave earlier and walk slowly instead of rushing for a bus.
会。我早些出门，慢慢走，不再赶公交。
A
That sounds ideal. Is there anything you miss?
听着理想，有什么让你怀念的吗？
B
The old area had more places open late. Here, a late dinner often means cooking at home, which I enjoy only when I still have some energy.
旧街区更多店开到很晚。这里晚吃饭常要自己做，我得还有精力才喜欢。
A
So the area works for your usual day, but not every possible day.
所以这里适合平常的一天，并非所有情况。
B
Exactly. I would call it a good fit, not a perfect place.
对。我会说它适合我，不是完美的地方。

dialogues.title: 周末不是同一种休息
dialogues.scene: 朋友商量一起过周末
dialogues.intent: 解释个人偏好并协商
dialogues.question: 为什么两人想要不同安排？
dialogues.answer: 工作日社交和体力负担不同。
dialogues.challenge: 介绍自己怎样休息，并与朋友找到共同安排。
rows: A
I thought a busy Saturday would be fun. You seem unsure.
我以为热闹的周六很好玩，你好像不确定。
B
My weekdays involve talking to customers almost constantly. On Saturday, I want space to think, even if I am still doing something active.
我工作日几乎不停地和顾客说话。周六想留点思考空间，活动身体也可以。
A
For me, working alone makes a crowded café feel relaxing.
我独自工作，人多的咖啡馆反而让我放松。
B
That makes sense. Rest depends partly on what we are resting from.
有道理。休息方式部分取决于我们想摆脱什么。
A
Could we walk first and meet others afterward?
能先散步，再见其他人吗？
B
Yes, if I can leave before the evening gets too late.
可以，前提是晚上不要太迟，我能先走。
A
I'll explain that to the group so nobody takes it personally.
我会跟大家解释，免得有人往心里去。
B
Thanks. Choosing quiet time does not mean I dislike their company.
谢谢。选择安静时间不代表我不喜欢他们。

dialogues.title: 停车场变成了花园
dialogues.scene: 朋友沿社区花园散步
dialogues.intent: 按时间空间讲清变化
dialogues.question: 变化对街区带来什么意义？
dialogues.answer: 从停车空间变成可相遇和活动的公共空间。
dialogues.challenge: 讲述一个熟悉地方的变化，包含过去、过程和今日细节。
rows: A
Was this always a garden? The paths look quite new.
这里一直是花园吗？步道看着很新。
B
No, it was a neglected car park. Cars blocked the entrance, and the far corner filled with rubbish. People crossed it quickly rather than stopping here.
不是，以前是破旧停车场。车堵入口，远处角落堆垃圾，大家只快速穿过。
A
What made the change possible?
什么让改变成为可能？
B
Residents proposed a garden, but the first plan had no accessible path.
居民提议建花园，但初稿没有无障碍步道。
A
So it needed more than plants and a few benches.
所以不只是种植物、放几张长椅。
B
Exactly. After several meetings, they added wider paths and kept an open area. Now older neighbors sit near the herbs while children play where the cars used to be.
对。几次会议后加宽步道，保留开阔区。现在老人坐在香草旁，孩子在旧车位玩。
A
Has everyone accepted it?
所有人都接受了吗？
B
Not everyone. Some still miss the parking, so nearby loading spaces remain important.
没有。有些人仍想要停车位，所以附近装卸位仍很重要。

dialogues.title: 一条街突然有了人
dialogues.scene: 同事回访旧商业街
dialogues.intent: 描述变化并保留负面影响
dialogues.question: 步行化并非完全成功的原因是什么？
dialogues.answer: 部分商户配送变难，调整仍在进行。
dialogues.challenge: 描述一项变化，公平介绍一个受益者和一个受影响者。
rows: A
I barely recognize this street. Where did all the traffic go?
我几乎认不出这条街了，车流去哪了？
B
The center became pedestrian-only last spring. At first it looked empty, but cafés added tables and people gradually started staying rather than passing through.
去年春天中心变成步行区。起初空荡荡，咖啡馆加桌后，大家逐渐愿意停留。
A
Did businesses welcome it immediately?
商家立即欢迎这个变化吗？
B
Some did. Others struggled because deliveries could no longer stop outside.
有些欢迎，另一些因为无法门口卸货而困难。
A
How was that addressed?
怎么处理的？
B
There are delivery hours before the shops open, though smaller businesses say the window is too short. The street improved, but the practical details are still being adjusted.
店铺开门前有送货时段，但小商户说时间太短。街道改善了，实际细节仍在调整。
A
That sounds more realistic than calling it a complete success.
比称为彻底成功更符合现实。
B
Yes. A place changes through many small decisions, not one announcement.
对。地方由许多小决定改变，不是一次公告。

dialogues.title: 教会我修东西的人
dialogues.scene: 朋友谈起维修导师
dialogues.intent: 用行为证据描述人物
dialogues.question: 导师怎样影响说话者？
dialogues.answer: 让他先观察、敢尝试并承认不知道。
dialogues.challenge: 介绍影响你的人，用两件行为说明而不只列形容词。
rows: A
Why do you always mention your neighbor when something breaks?
东西坏了，你为什么总提那位邻居？
B
He taught me to repair things. When my lamp stopped working, he did not immediately fix it. He asked what I had noticed and let me explain my guess.
他教我维修。灯坏时他没马上修，而是问我观察到什么，让我解释猜想。
A
Wasn't that frustrating when you wanted a quick answer?
你想快点知道答案时，不觉得烦吗？
B
At first, yes. Then I realized he was teaching me a process.
开始会，后来明白他在教我一种方法。
A
What made him a good teacher rather than just a skilled repairer?
什么让他成为好老师，而不只是维修能手？
B
He never laughed at a wrong guess. He also said 'I don't know' when he was unsure, which showed me that expertise does not mean pretending to have every answer.
他从不笑话猜错，也会在不确定时说不知道。这让我明白，专业不是装作什么都会。
A
Do you use that approach when helping other people?
你帮助别人时也用这种方法吗？
B
I try to, though I still catch myself rushing to solve things for them.
我努力这样做，不过仍会发现自己急着替他们解决。

dialogues.title: 严厉的同事其实在帮忙
dialogues.scene: 新员工反思同事反馈
dialogues.intent: 通过具体事件修正人物判断
dialogues.question: 为什么改变了对同事的看法？
dialogues.answer: 同事既指出问题，也主动帮助并认可进步。
dialogues.challenge: 讲述一次改变你看法的经历，说明之前与之后。
rows: A
I used to think my colleague disliked me. Her comments were always direct.
我以前以为同事不喜欢我，她评论总很直接。
B
