What changed your mind?
什么改变了你的想法？
A
After a difficult presentation, she stayed to help me reorganize the slides. She pointed out problems, but also showed exactly how to make the explanation clearer.
一次困难的演讲后，她留下帮我重排幻灯片。她指出问题，也具体示范如何讲清楚。
B
So the criticism came with support.
所以批评也伴着支持。
A
Yes, and she later told the manager I had improved.
对，后来她还告诉经理我有进步。
B
Would you now describe her as kind?
现在你会说她善良吗？
A
In a practical way. I still find her tone uncomfortable sometimes, but I no longer assume discomfort means hostility. I ask what she intends before reacting.
是实际行动上的善意。有时语气仍让我不舒服，但我不再认定那是敌意，会先问她的用意。
B
That sounds like you both learned how to work together.
听起来你们都学会了怎样共事。

dialogues.title: 学校该不该教做饭
dialogues.scene: 朋友从厨房经验聊教育
dialogues.intent: 从个人经历发展有限原则
dialogues.question: 实践技能是否应取代基础课程？
dialogues.answer: 不应取代，可与阅读和计算结合。
dialogues.challenge: 为学校提出一项实用课程，说明机制和限制。
rows: A
I wish school had taught me to cook. Should practical skills replace some subjects?
真希望学校教过做饭，实用技能该取代一些科目吗？
B

They deserve space, but replacing core subjects creates a false choice. Cooking can involve reading instructions, estimating costs, and understanding nutrition, so the subjects can support each other.
应有位置，但取代基础科目把选择变得过于简单。做饭涉及读说明、估成本、懂营养，科目可以相互支持。
A
That works in theory. Teachers already have too much to cover.
理论上不错，老师已经有太多内容。
B
Then start with a small shared project rather than a whole new course.
那先做一个小型联合项目，不必开全新课程。
A
Would every student benefit equally?
每个学生受益一样吗？
B
Probably not. Some learn these skills at home; others lack the equipment or support. Schools could offer a common starting point without assuming all families have the same resources.
可能不同。有些在家学过，有些缺设备或帮助。学校能给共同起点，不假设家庭资源一样。
A
And assess whether students can actually use the skills?
再检查学生是否真会使用？
B
Yes, while keeping safety, costs, and teachers' preparation in view.
对，也要考虑安全、费用和教师准备。

dialogues.title: 手机在教室里的位置
dialogues.scene: 家长讨论手机管理
dialogues.intent: 比较规则与教育目标
dialogues.question: 为什么不是简单全禁或全开放？
dialogues.answer: 不同活动需求不同，也要教自我管理。
dialogues.challenge: 提出一条清晰规则，并解释一个合理例外。
rows: A
My son says phone bans are unfair because phones can help learning.
儿子说禁手机不公平，因为手机能帮助学习。
B
They can, but useful technology can still distract when there is no clear purpose.
能，但没有明确目的时，有用的技术仍会分心。
A
Would allowing them only when the teacher asks be enough?
只在老师要求时用，够吗？
B
It is a workable starting rule. Later, students also need practice making sensible choices themselves; permanent external control does not teach every part of self-management.
这能作为起始规则。之后学生也需要练习自己合理选择，持续外部控制无法教会全部自我管理。
A
That sounds hard to supervise.
听着很难监督。
B
Yes, which is why we need consistent routines and limited exceptions, not vague permission.
对，所以需要一致流程和有限例外，不是模糊允许。
A
Could parents know the reasons behind the rules?
家长能了解规则背后的理由吗？
B
Certainly. Clear explanations help us respond together when problems appear.
当然。解释清楚，出现问题时我们才能共同回应。

dialogues.title: 朋友的一句追问
dialogues.scene: 朋友讨论搬去小城市
dialogues.intent: 应对追问并澄清立场
dialogues.question: 说话者是否认为所有人都该搬走？
dialogues.answer: 没有，只是自己的取舍适合目前生活。
dialogues.challenge: 朋友质疑你的一项选择，先澄清再解释。
rows: A
You are moving to a smaller city. Do you think big cities are bad places to live?
你要搬去小城市，是觉得大城市不适合生活吗？
B
Not generally. I am choosing shorter travel and lower housing costs at this stage. Someone building a career in a specialized field might reasonably make a different choice.
不是普遍这么想。我目前更想要短通勤和低房价，发展专业职业的人完全可能合理地做不同选择。
A
But aren't you giving up opportunities?
但你不是放弃了机会吗？
B
Some, yes. I do not want to pretend there is no cost.
有些是。我不想装作没有代价。
A
What would make you regret the move?
什么会让你后悔搬家？
B
If I became isolated or could not find suitable work. That is why I am renting first and keeping professional contacts, rather than treating the move as irreversible.
如果变得孤立或找不到合适工作。所以先租房、保持职业联系，不把搬家当作不可逆决定。
A
So you are testing a direction rather than declaring one city type superior.
所以你在尝试一个方向，不是宣称某类城市更好。
B
Exactly. My preference needs that qualification.
对。我的偏好需要这个限定。

dialogues.title: 小决定能变成公共规则吗
dialogues.scene: 朋友讨论限制汽车
dialogues.intent: 区分个人经验与公共政策
dialogues.question: 自己不需要车能否证明别人也不需要？
dialogues.answer: 不能，工作、地点和身体条件不同。
dialogues.challenge: 用自己的经历支持观点，同时主动说明不适用情况。
rows: A
You manage without a car. Should the city restrict car ownership?
你没车也过得好，城市应限制拥有汽车吗？
B
My experience shows one possibility, not a rule for everyone. I live near reliable transport and do not carry equipment or care for someone who needs frequent travel.
我的经历展示一种可能，不是普遍规则。我住在可靠交通旁，不搬设备，也没照护经常出行的人。
A
Then can personal experience tell us anything useful?
那个人经验能告诉我们有用的东西吗？
B
Yes. It can reveal what makes a choice practical and suggest questions to investigate.
能。它能显示选择可行的条件，并提出调查问题。
A
What question would you investigate first?
你首先调查什么？
B
Whether better evening services actually reduce car journeys in different neighborhoods. If alternatives improve, restrictions become easier to justify, but the effects still need checking.
不同街区改善晚班服务能否减少汽车出行。替代方式改善后，限制更有依据，但仍需检查效果。
A
That leaves room for exceptions rather than abandoning the aim.
这样保留例外，也没有放弃目标。
B
Right. A clear aim does not require an absolute rule.
对。明确目标不需要绝对规则。

dialogues.title: 城市出行改变了多少
dialogues.scene: 同事讨论通勤报告
dialogues.intent: 概括趋势并区分预测
dialogues.question: 哪部分不是已经发生的变化？
dialogues.answer: 明年的自行车增长是预测。
dialogues.challenge: 用三句话概括你熟悉的一种变化，并指出未知部分。
rows: A
The report suggests a major shift away from cars. Is that your reading too?
报告显示出行明显转离汽车，你也这样理解吗？
B
Broadly, yes. Bus use rose steadily, while driving fell mainly after the new route opened. Cycling grew more slowly, so I would not describe all alternatives as changing at the same pace.
总体是。公交稳定增长，开新线路后开车才明显下降。骑车增长更慢，不能说替代方式都按相同步调变化。
A
The final line shows cycling rising sharply next year.
最后一条线显示明年骑车大幅增加。
B
That line is a forecast, not another year of observed travel.
那是预测，不是又一年的实际出行记录。
A
What does the forecast depend on?
预测依赖什么？
B
Completion of the cycle lanes and continued funding. If either changes, the estimate could change too. We should separate the clear past trend from the conditional future expectation.
依赖自行车道完成和持续资金支持。任何一项变化，估计也可能变。应分开明确的过去趋势和有条件的未来预期。
A
Then our summary needs fewer numbers and a clearer distinction.
那总结需要少些数字，更清楚地区分。
B
Exactly. Detail should help people understand the pattern, not obscure it.
对。细节应帮助理解规律，不是把它藏住。

dialogues.title: 店里的销量变化
dialogues.scene: 店主查看季节销售
dialogues.intent: 按主要变化比较而不逐项罗列
dialogues.question: 为什么不预期冬天保持夏季销量？
dialogues.answer: 天气和商品需求会变化。
dialogues.challenge: 解释一个趋势，并提出一个会让趋势停止的条件。
rows: A
Cold drinks doubled this summer. We should double next winter's stock too.
夏季冷饮翻倍了，冬季库存也翻倍吧。
B
The broad pattern is seasonal: cold drinks rose as temperatures increased, while hot drinks fell. Extending the summer line into winter ignores the change in conditions.
总体是季节规律：温度升高，冷饮增加、热饮下降。把夏季趋势延到冬天忽视了条件变化。
A
But our total customer numbers also grew.
但总顾客数也增加了。
B
True. That may support higher total stock, though not the same mix.
对。这可能支持增加总库存，但不一定保持相同比例。
A
Could we compare last winter and adjust for the extra customers?
能对比去年冬天，再按新增顾客调整吗？
B
Yes, as a starting estimate. Then place smaller repeat orders and review actual sales weekly, rather than committing to one large prediction.
可以，作为起始估计。之后小批补货、每周看实际销售，不押在一次大预测上。
A
That gives us room to respond without running out immediately.
这样能留调整空间，又不至于马上断货。
B
Exactly. A forecast should support a decision, not replace judgment.
对。预测应支持决定，不代替判断。

dialogues.title: 小分馆为什么借书多
dialogues.scene: 馆员比较分馆服务
dialogues.intent: 选择有意义的比较
dialogues.question: 借书多能否直接说明更有效率？
dialogues.answer: 不能，规模、客群和服务种类不同。
dialogues.challenge: 比较两个你熟悉的地方，避免把一个指标当整体优劣。
rows: A
The smaller branch lends more books. It must be more efficient.
小分馆借出更多书，一定更高效。
B
It has more nearby families, while the larger branch hosts workshops and research services. Loans are useful, but they do not capture all the work each branch does.
它附近家庭更多，大分馆还办工作坊、做研究服务。借阅有用，但不能覆盖两馆全部工作。
A
Then which comparison would be fairer?
那怎么比更公平？
B
Start with similar services, opening hours, and the communities they serve.
先比较相似服务、开放时间和所服务社区。
A
The large branch has more evening visitors but fewer children's loans.
大分馆晚间访客更多，儿童借阅却较少。
B
That suggests different needs rather than a simple winner. We can ask whether each branch meets its local demand, and examine costs without assuming every visit has the same purpose.
这说明需求不同，不是简单分胜负。可以看各馆是否满足本地需求，查费用时也别假设每次到访目的相同。
A
So our report should group meaningful differences rather than list every cell.
所以报告应归纳有意义的差别，不逐格罗列。
B
Yes, and leave unsupported explanations out of the conclusions.
对，不把没依据的解释放进结论。

dialogues.title: 两家健身房如何选
dialogues.scene: 朋友比较健身房
dialogues.intent: 根据需要比较选项
dialogues.question: 大健身房为何不一定最适合？
dialogues.answer: 设备多，但通勤和使用时间可能不合适。
dialogues.challenge: 比较两个选择，先说明你的需求再给判断。
rows: A
This gym has twice as many machines. It looks like the better deal.
这家器械多一倍，看着更划算。
B
For someone who needs those machines, perhaps. You mostly swim after work, and the smaller gym has a pool ten minutes from your office.
对需要那些器械的人也许是。你主要下班游泳，小健身房离办公室十分钟，还有泳池。
A
The larger one has longer opening hours.
大健身房开放时间更长。
B
Are those extra hours times you would actually use?
多出来的那些时间你真会用吗？
A
Probably not. I rarely exercise before work.
可能不会。我很少上班前锻炼。
B
Then compare travel time, the pool schedule, and the full membership cost. More features only add value when they match your routine.
那比较通勤、泳池时段和完整会费。更多功能只有符合日常安排才有价值。
A
I should try the evening session before signing a year-long contract.
签一年合同前我应该试试晚间时段。
B
Good. Real use can reveal differences the brochure cannot show.
好。实际使用能发现宣传册显示不了的差别。

dialogues.title: 纸离开回收桶之后
dialogues.scene: 朋友参观纸张回收站
dialogues.intent: 解释顺序、分支与循环
dialogues.question: 所有收到的纸都会变成新纸吗？
dialogues.answer: 不会，受污染材料会被分出。
dialogues.challenge: 不看台词向朋友讲一个熟悉流程，说明一个分支。
rows: A
Once paper goes into the bin, does it simply become new paper?
纸进回收桶后，就直接变成新纸吗？
B
Not immediately. It is collected and sorted first. Clean paper can be processed, but heavily contaminated material is removed because it can affect the whole batch.
不会立即变。先收集、分类，干净纸能处理，严重污染材料要分出，否则会影响整批。
A
What happens to the acceptable material?
合格材料之后怎样？
B
It is mixed with water, cleaned, and formed into new sheets.
与水混合，清洁，再制成新纸。
A
So the cycle can repeat forever?
所以这个循环可以永远重复？
B
No. Fibers become shorter with repeated processing, so new material may be added. It is a cycle, but there are losses and limits at several stages.
不能。反复处理让纤维变短，可能要加入新材料。这是循环，但几个阶段都有损耗和限制。
A
Then keeping food out of the paper bin helps the process earlier on.
那不把食物扔进纸回收桶能在前端帮助流程。
B
Exactly. What people do before collection affects what we can recover.
对。收集前人们的做法影响能回收什么。

dialogues.title: 退货不一定回到货架
dialogues.scene: 顾客了解退货流程
dialogues.intent: 解释检查后的不同路径
dialogues.question: 退回商品有哪几种去向？
dialogues.answer: 重新销售、维修、折价处理或回收。
dialogues.challenge: 解释一件退货如何处理，不省略判断条件。
rows: A
I assumed returned products went straight back on sale.
我以为退货直接重新出售。
B
They are checked first. Unopened items may return to stock, while damaged ones go to repair or recycling. The route depends on their condition and the product's safety requirements.
先检查。未拆封的可能回库存，损坏的去维修或回收。路径取决于状态和安全要求。
A
What about something opened but barely used?
拆封但几乎没用的呢？
B
Some can be sold at a discount with the condition clearly described.
有些能折价卖，并清楚说明状态。
A
Who decides whether an item is safe?
谁判断商品安全？
B
Trained staff follow inspection rules, and uncertain cases are set aside. We cannot assume that appearance alone tells us whether a product is suitable to sell again.
培训过的员工按规则检查，不确定的先放一旁。不能假设外观能说明商品是否适合再卖。
A
That explains why a return takes longer than simply scanning a box.
难怪退货不只是扫一下盒子，需要更多时间。
B
Yes. The simple customer step starts a more detailed process here.
对。顾客简单的一步，在这里启动更细的流程。

dialogues.title: 博物馆免费才能公平吗
dialogues.scene: 朋友讨论博物馆收费
dialogues.intent: 公平呈现双方并提出限定立场
dialogues.question: 说话者建议怎样收费？
dialogues.answer: 基本参观免费，部分特展收费并有减免。
dialogues.challenge: 先准确复述反方，再说明自己的有条件选择。
rows: A
Museums should be free. Charging people keeps culture away from them.
博物馆应该免费，收费让人远离文化。
B
Access matters, but maintaining collections and paying staff also costs money. If ticket revenue disappears without replacement funding, shorter opening hours could make access worse.
可及性重要，但维护藏品和发工资也要钱。票款消失却没替代资金，缩短开放反而让人更难参观。
A
So you support charging everyone?
所以你支持所有人都交钱？
B
Not necessarily. I favor free basic entry with carefully priced special exhibitions.
不一定。我支持基本参观免费，特展谨慎定价。
A
People with less money could still miss the best exhibitions.
钱少的人仍可能错过最好展览。
B
Then discounts and free periods must be real and easy to use. My position depends on those safeguards, not on the idea that any charge is automatically fair.
那优惠和免费时段必须真实又易用。我的立场依赖这些保障，不是觉得任何收费自动公平。
A
And public funding still has a role?
公共资金仍有作用？
B
Definitely. Tickets should support access, not become the only reason a museum exists.
当然。门票应支持参观，不成为博物馆唯一存在理由。

dialogues.title: 公园活动要不要收费
dialogues.scene: 邻居讨论公共课程
dialogues.intent: 区分基本开放与增值活动
dialogues.question: 为何收费不应影响普通入园？
dialogues.answer: 公园是共享公共空间。
dialogues.challenge: 免费课程挤满，提出公平预约方式。
rows: A
A paid yoga class in a public park feels wrong to me.
公共公园里的付费瑜伽课让我觉得不对。
B
I see why, though instructors need to be paid. A class can have a fee without making ordinary use of the park depend on payment.
我理解，不过教练也需要工资。课程收费不一定要让普通使用公园也付费。
A
But the class occupies the best lawn every evening.
但课程每天晚上占最好的草坪。
B
Then the schedule is a problem, regardless of the fee.
那时间安排有问题，不论是否收费。
A
Would limited sessions and some free places be reasonable?
限制场次并留一些免费名额合理吗？
B
Yes, if the remaining space stays open and the free places are allocated clearly. We should check how other users experience the arrangement, not only count class participants.
合理，前提是其他空间开放、免费名额分配清楚。应检查其他使用者的感受，不只数参加人数。
A
That addresses my main concern better than saying classes are beneficial.
这比只说课程有益，更能回应我的担心。
B
A benefit does not remove the need to consider who bears the inconvenience.
有好处，也仍需考虑谁承担不便。

dialogues.title: 独居不等于孤独
dialogues.scene: 社区讨论居民支持
dialogues.intent: 使问题与方案对应
dialogues.question: 为什么聚餐不能解决所有问题？
dialogues.answer: 有人缺交通、行动能力或稳定关系。
dialogues.challenge: 选一种孤独的原因，提出对应措施和检查办法。
rows: A
More residents live alone. Let's organize a large monthly dinner.
更多居民独居了，我们办大型月度聚餐吧。
B
It may help some, but living alone and feeling lonely are not the same. We should ask what kind of connection people want and what prevents it.
可能帮助一些人，但独居和孤独不同。应问人们想要什么联系，以及什么阻碍它。
A
What barriers do you hear about most?
你最常听到哪些阻碍？
B
Mobility, transport, and not knowing anyone well enough to join a group.
行动能力、交通，还有没熟到能一起入群的人。
A
A dinner would not fix the first two.
聚餐解决不了前两项。
B
Exactly. Transport support could improve access, while small repeated meetings may build trust. Different causes need different responses, and nobody should feel forced to socialize.
对。交通支持改善可达性，小型重复见面能建立信任。不同原因需要不同回应，也不该逼人社交。
A
Let's invite suggestions and pilot two small options.
征集建议，并试两种小规模方案吧。
B
Then ask whether participants feel more connected, not just whether they attended.
之后问联系感是否增强，不只问有没有参加。

dialogues.title: 远程团队里的疏离
dialogues.scene: 经理讨论线上团队关系
dialogues.intent: 将措施与具体困难匹配
dialogues.question: 为什么线上派对不够？
dialogues.answer: 问题来自协作断裂和不知道向谁求助。
dialogues.challenge: 提出一种工作中的连接办法，并解释不会增加无效会议。
rows: A
People feel disconnected. Another online party might improve morale.
大家觉得疏离，再办线上派对可能提士气。
B
Maybe, but my problem is not a lack of entertainment. I do not know who to ask when work gets stuck, and messages disappear across several channels.
也许，但我缺的不是娱乐。工作卡住时不知道问谁，消息散在多个频道。
A
So the disconnection is practical as well as social.
所以疏离既是社交问题，也是实际工作问题。
B
Yes. Clear contacts and regular small check-ins would help more.
对。明确联系人、定期小范围沟通更有用。
A
Would that create even more meetings?
那会增加更多会议吗？
B
Only if badly designed. A short optional help session could replace long message chains, while people who prefer written communication should still have a clear route.
设计差才会。简短可选求助会能代替长消息链，喜欢文字沟通的人仍应有明确渠道。
A
Let's test that and ask whether work becomes easier.
我们试试，并问工作是否变容易。
B
Good. Better relationships can grow from reliable everyday cooperation.
好。可靠的日常合作能带来更好关系。

dialogues.title: 摘要少了一个限定
dialogues.scene: 同事核对交通报告摘要
dialogues.intent: 保持改述范围和程度
dialogues.question: 摘要如何夸大原文？
dialogues.answer: 把部分线路改善写成所有服务改善。
dialogues.challenge: 用自己的话转述一段信息，保留对象、程度与时间。
rows: A
My summary says public transport improved across the city. Is that accurate?
我总结说全城公共交通改善了，准确吗？
B
The report says evening buses improved on three central routes. Your wording expands both the area and the type of service, so it makes a broader claim than the evidence supports.
报告说三条中心线路晚班公交改善了。你的措辞扩大了地区和服务种类，比证据支持的结论更广。
A
I was trying to avoid repeating the original phrase.
我想避免重复原来的措辞。
B
Changing words is fine; changing the claim is not.
换词可以，但不能换了结论。
A
How about 'Selected central routes now offer better evening service'?
“部分中心线路现在提供更好的晚间服务”怎样？
B
Much closer. Also keep the time period if the change was only temporary. A clear summary preserves the important boundaries even when it leaves out minor details.
接近多了。如果变化只是暂时的，也要保留时段。清楚的总结可以省小细节，但需保留重要边界。
A
I'll check each sentence against the actual scope before sharing it.
分享前我会逐句核对实际范围。
B
That will save readers from drawing conclusions the report never made.
这样能避免读者得出报告没提出的结论。

dialogues.title: 客户说的不是“马上”
dialogues.scene: 团队确认客户需求
dialogues.intent: 准确转述意图和强度
dialogues.question: 客户是否要求立即上线？
dialogues.answer: 没有，要求尽快给出可行日期。
dialogues.challenge: 把一条含糊请求转述给同事，并说清仍需确认什么。
rows: A
The client wants the website live immediately, so we need to work tonight.
客户要网站马上上线，所以今晚得加班。
B
Did they say that, or ask when we could launch?
他们这么说了，还是问什么时候能上线？
A
They wrote, 'Please give us the earliest realistic date.'
他们写的是“请给最早可行的日期”。
B
Then they are asking for an estimate with practical limits. Turning that into an immediate deadline removes the word 'realistic' and creates pressure they may never have intended.
那是在要有实际限制的估计。改成马上截止，去掉了“可行”，制造他们可能从没打算施加的压力。
A
I reacted to the urgency rather than the full sentence.
我回应的是紧迫语气，不是完整句子。
B
Let's send the earliest safe date and explain what still needs checking.
给出最早安全日期，解释还需检查什么。
A
We can also ask whether a limited first version would meet their need.
也可以问有限的首版是否满足需求。
B
Exactly. Clarification is more useful than guessing and exhausting the team.
对。澄清比猜测再累坏团队更有用。

dialogues.title: 听起来同意，其实有保留
dialogues.scene: 组织者讨论会议场地
dialogues.intent: 从后续理由理解礼貌保留
dialogues.question: 同事真正担心什么？
dialogues.answer: 入口台阶和交通可达性。
dialogues.challenge: 礼貌承认一个优点，再说明实质顾虑和替代。
rows: A
You said the venue was impressive. Shall I confirm the booking?
你说场地很漂亮，我确认预订吗？
B
It is impressive, certainly. I am just wondering how easily everyone can get inside, given the steps at the entrance and the lack of a nearby bus stop.
确实漂亮。我只是想知道，入口有台阶、附近没公交站，大家是否都容易进去。
A
So you are not fully comfortable with the choice.
所以你并不完全满意这个选择。
B
Not yet. The appearance is a strength, but accessibility matters more for this event.
还没有。外观是优点，但这次活动可达性更重要。
A
Would arranging transport and a temporary ramp address it?
安排交通和临时坡道能解决吗？
B
Possibly, if both are reliable and the venue approves them. Otherwise the community hall is less striking but already suitable for the people attending.
可能，前提是都可靠且场地方同意。否则社区大厅不那么出众，但已经适合参加的人。
A
I'll compare the full arrangements before making a decision.
我会比较完整安排后再决定。
B
Thanks. My compliment was about the room, not approval of the whole plan.
谢谢。我称赞的是房间，不代表批准整个计划。

dialogues.title: “很有意思”的提案
dialogues.scene: 同事确认反馈含义
dialogues.intent: 澄清模糊评价而不猜态度
dialogues.question: 有意思是否意味着支持？
dialogues.answer: 不意味着，仍有执行成本担忧。
dialogues.challenge: 别人只说“挺有意思”，自然追问有用反馈。
rows: A
You called my proposal interesting. Are you ready to support it?
你说提案有意思，准备支持它了吗？
B
I am interested in the idea, but I have not worked through the staffing it requires. I meant that it deserves discussion, not that every part is ready to go.
我对想法有兴趣，但没想清需要的人员。我是说值得讨论，不是说每部分都能立即实施。
A
Which part creates the biggest concern?
哪部分最让你担心？
B
The promise to answer every request within an hour.
承诺一小时内回答所有请求。
A
We could limit that promise to working hours and a smaller pilot group.
可以限于工作时间和较小试点群体。
B
That would make it more manageable. I would support testing the revised version, as long as we track workload and do not quietly expand the promise before reviewing it.
这样更可控。我支持测试修改版，但要记录工作量，不在评估前悄悄扩大承诺。
A
So your support is conditional, and I should record those conditions.
所以你有条件支持，我应该记录那些条件。
B
Exactly. Asking directly is better than interpreting politeness as agreement.
对。直接问比把礼貌解读成同意更好。

dialogues.title: 两个作者在争同一件事吗
dialogues.scene: 读书小组比较图书馆评论
dialogues.intent: 辨别价值排序与证据差异
dialogues.question: 两篇评论的核心分歧是什么？
dialogues.answer: 对安静学习和公共活动的优先次序不同。
dialogues.challenge: 公平复述两个观点，说明分歧是事实还是价值。
rows: A
One article says the library is too noisy; the other praises its activities.
一篇说图书馆太吵，另一篇赞扬活动。
B
They may agree that activities increased. The disagreement is partly about what the library should prioritize: quiet study or a place where the wider community meets.
他们可能都认同活动增加。分歧部分在图书馆该优先提供安静学习，还是让更广的社区相聚。
A
So more visitor numbers would not settle the argument.
所以更多到访人数解决不了争论。
B
Right. Numbers can show use, but not automatically decide which use matters most.
对。数字显示使用情况，不自动决定哪种用途最重要。
A
Could separate spaces satisfy both?
分开空间能满足双方吗？
B
Perhaps, depending on the building and cost. We should check whether the proposed quiet room is genuinely protected from sound, rather than assuming a sign creates silence.
可能，取决于楼和费用。应检查安静室是否真正隔音，不是假设一块牌子就带来安静。
A
Then we can combine compatible needs without pretending the priorities are identical.
那可以兼顾相容需求，不假装优先次序完全相同。
B
Exactly. A useful compromise makes the remaining tension visible.
对。有用的折中会让剩余矛盾看得见。

dialogues.title: 远程办公的两种故事
dialogues.scene: 朋友比较两篇工作评论
dialogues.intent: 保留不同人群的经验
dialogues.question: 两篇评论为何都可能有道理？
dialogues.answer: 讨论的工作性质和生活条件不同。
dialogues.challenge: 综合两种经历，给一个有范围的建议。
rows: A
These articles reach opposite conclusions about working from home.
两篇文章对居家工作得出相反结论。
B

The first describes experienced staff with quiet rooms. The second focuses on new employees sharing crowded housing. Their evidence concerns different conditions, so the contrast may be less direct than it seems.
第一篇讲有安静房间的资深员工，第二篇关注拥挤合租的新员工。证据条件不同，未必像表面那样直接冲突。
A
Should we avoid drawing any conclusion then?
那应该完全不下结论吗？
B
No. We can identify which conditions make remote work easier or harder.
不用。可以找哪些条件让远程工作更容易或更难。
A
A flexible policy with support for new staff seems reasonable.
灵活政策加新员工支持似乎合理。
B
Yes, but flexibility must be genuine. If promotion informally favors people in the office, an official choice may still carry an unequal cost.
是，但灵活性必须真实。如果晋升暗中偏爱在办公室的人，正式选择仍可能带来不均等代价。
A
Then we need to inspect the practice as well as the written rule.
那既要检查书面规则，也要检查实际做法。
B
Exactly. Different accounts can point us toward better questions.
对。不同叙述能引出更好的问题。

dialogues.title: 最终集合时间是几点
dialogues.scene: 学生确认实验室参观变更
dialogues.intent: 追踪数字修正与最终安排
dialogues.question: 最终何时何地集合？
dialogues.answer: 十点十五在东门，实验室参观十一点开始。
dialogues.challenge: 朋友只记得旧时间，完整说明最终安排与原因。
rows: A
Meet at nine thirty outside the main entrance—sorry, that was the original plan.
九点半在正门集合——抱歉，那是原计划。
B
What has changed?
改了什么？
A
The first lab session is now at eleven, and the main entrance is closed. Meet at ten fifteen by the east gate; the extra time is for signing in, not another activity.
首场实验室参观改为十一点，正门关闭。十点十五东门集合，提前时间用于登记，不是另一项活动。
B
So ten fifteen is the meeting time, and eleven is the actual visit.
所以十点十五集合，十一点正式参观。
A
Exactly. Also, the group limit is twelve, not twenty as the email stated.
对。另外人数上限是十二，不是邮件里的二十。
B
Do we need to bring identification?
需要带身份证件吗？
A
Yes, a photo ID. Bags stay in lockers, but notebooks are allowed. I'll send one corrected message so nobody has to combine several versions.
需要带带照片的证件。包放储物柜，笔记本能带。我会发一条修正版，免得大家拼几个版本。
B
Please mark it as the final schedule. I'll forward that version only.
请标为最终日程，我只转发那版。

dialogues.title: 改了两次的取货地点
dialogues.scene: 顾客确认家具配送
dialogues.intent: 核对最终数字和限制
dialogues.question: 顾客最终在哪里等？
dialogues.answer: 三号楼后门，不是最初的正门。
dialogues.challenge: 向室友转述地点、时间范围和搬运限制。
rows: A
The message says building two at four. Is that still correct?
消息写二号楼四点，还正确吗？
B
No, the address was corrected to building three, and the arrival window is four to five. Use the back entrance because the front path is being repaired.
不，地址改成三号楼，到达范围四点到五点。正面道路维修，要走后门。
A
Does the delivery include taking the sofa upstairs?
配送包括把沙发搬上楼吗？
B
Only if the lift works. The booking covers delivery to your floor, not carrying it up stairs.
电梯能用才包括。预订包含送到所在楼层，不包含走楼梯搬运。
A
The lift is working, but it is quite small.
电梯能用，不过很小。
B
Please send its doorway measurements before we arrive. If the sofa will not fit, we need to discuss another arrangement rather than decide at the entrance.
请来之前发电梯门尺寸。如果沙发放不进，我们要提前讨论其他安排，不要到了门口才决定。
A
I'll measure it now and confirm the corrected details in one message.
我现在测量，把修改后的详情放一条消息确认。
B
Great. That will prevent another avoidable trip.
好，能避免又一次白跑。

dialogues.title: 远程试点该怎样继续
dialogues.scene: 团队综合两份试点材料
dialogues.intent: 综合不同证据形成可调整建议
dialogues.question: 效率和满意度是否说明同一件事？
dialogues.answer: 不是，需要分别看产出与体验。
dialogues.challenge: 给出建议，指出依据、风险和复查时间。
rows: A
The task report shows faster completion, but the survey shows lower team connection.
任务报告显示完成更快，调查却显示团队联系变弱。
B
Those findings can both be true. One measures output and the other experience, so combining them into a single success score would hide the choice we need to make.
两项都可能是真的。一个测产出、一个测体验，合成单一成功分会隐藏我们要做的取舍。
A
Would returning everyone to the office solve it?
让所有人回办公室能解决吗？
B
It might improve contact, but could remove the gains from focused work.
可能改善联系，但会失去专注工作的收益。
A
What is your recommendation?
你的建议是什么？
B
Keep flexible days, add planned collaboration time, and give new staff closer support. Review both output and connection after two months, including whether particular teams are worse off.
保留灵活天数，安排协作时间，更多支持新员工。两个月后复查产出和联系，包括是否有团队吃亏。
A
And allow changes if the problems persist?
问题持续就允许修改？
B
Yes. This should be a testable arrangement, not a permanent conclusion from one trial.
对。这应是可检验安排，不是一次试点得出的永久结论。

dialogues.title: 把健身建议用到自己身上
dialogues.scene: 朋友整合训练资料
dialogues.intent: 将一般证据迁移到个人条件
dialogues.question: 为什么不照抄两份计划？
dialogues.answer: 计划对象、目标与可用时间不同。
dialogues.challenge: 基于自己的条件设计行动，并说明需要调整的信号。
rows: A
One guide recommends daily sessions; another favors three longer sessions. Which is right?
一份指南推荐每天练，另一份推荐三次长练，哪个对？
B
Check who each plan is for. An experienced athlete and a beginner with a busy job do not need identical schedules, even if both plans have reasonable evidence behind them.
先看适用对象。经验丰富的运动员和工作忙的新手不需要一样安排，即使两份计划都有合理依据。
A
I mostly want enough energy for daily life.
我主要想有足够精力应付日常生活。
B
Then choose a modest routine you can sustain and increase it gradually.
那选能坚持的适量安排，逐渐增加。
A
Would short walks and two simple strength sessions be a useful start?
短步行加两次简单力量练习是好起点吗？
B

It sounds workable. Notice how you recover and whether the routine fits your week; if pain or persistent exhaustion appears, seek suitable advice rather than treating the plan as a rule you must obey.
听着可行。注意恢复和日程适配；出现疼痛或持续疲惫，要寻求适当建议，不把计划当必须服从的规则。
A
So the evidence guides me, but my conditions affect the application.
所以证据指导我，我的条件影响具体应用。
B
Exactly. A good transfer preserves the principle and adjusts the details.
对。好的迁移保留原则，调整细节。

dialogues.title: 防洪墙保护谁
dialogues.scene: 滨水社区听证后继续讨论
dialogues.intent: 综合风险、分配和不确定性
dialogues.question: 为什么需要墙外居民的意见？
dialogues.answer: 保护方案可能把水和风险转移给他们。
dialogues.challenge: 独立提出防洪建议，说明谁受益、谁承担成本及未知部分。
rows: A
The wall protects most homes. Does that make it the obvious choice?
防洪墙保护多数住宅，这就显然该选它吗？
B
It is a strong option, but not complete protection. The estimate depends on future water levels, and we need to check whether the wall redirects flooding toward homes outside it.
它是有力选择，但不是全面保护。估计依赖未来水位，也需检查是否把洪水转到墙外住宅。
A
Those households should not pay for everyone else's safety.
那些家庭不应为别人的安全买单。
B
Agreed. Relocation support may be needed, but it must be voluntary and sufficient.
同意。可能需要搬迁支持，但必须自愿且足够。
A
Some residents do not want to leave a place their families built.
有些居民不愿离开家人建立起来的地方。
B

That matters. My recommendation is to compare protection and relocation together, publish the remaining risks, and involve affected households before choosing—not present compensation after the decision.
这很重要。我建议一起比较保护和搬迁，公布剩余风险，选择前让受影响家庭参与，不是决定后才给补偿。
A
And include maintenance rather than only the construction price?
也要计维护费，不只建设价格？
B
Yes. A cheaper structure can become expensive if its upkeep or hidden impacts are ignored.
对。忽视维护和隐藏影响，便宜设施也可能变贵。

dialogues.title: 地下车库的防水计划
dialogues.scene: 住户委员会讨论车库积水
dialogues.intent: 比较设施方案与剩余风险
dialogues.question: 水泵为什么不能成为唯一办法？
dialogues.answer: 停电时可能失效，入口也需要管理。
dialogues.challenge: 向住户解释方案，用明确条件代替绝对安全承诺。
rows: A
A bigger pump costs less than rebuilding the entrance. Shall we choose it?
大水泵比重建入口便宜，选它吧？
B
What happens during a storm if the power fails?
暴风雨停电时怎么办？
A
We could add backup power, although that increases the cost.
可以加备用电，不过成本会增加。
B
Then compare the complete pump system with the complete entrance work. We also need warnings and a plan for moving cars, because neither option removes every possible risk.
那就比较完整泵系统和完整入口工程。还需要预警和移车计划，因为两种方案都不能去掉所有风险。
A
Would a raised entrance make wheelchair access harder?
抬高入口会让轮椅通行更难吗？
B
Potentially. Ask an accessibility specialist before accepting the drawing.
可能。接受图纸前请无障碍专家检查。
A
So we need one coordinated plan, not several fixes that conflict.
所以需要协调的整套计划，不是几项互相冲突的修补。
B
Exactly, with costs, responsibilities, and a clear account of what remains uncertain.
对，要列费用、责任，并说清哪些仍不确定。

dialogues.title: 作业是谁完成的
dialogues.scene: 大学讨论学习工具规则
dialogues.intent: 平衡学习支持与独立能力
dialogues.question: 为什么单看完成品不够？
dialogues.answer: 不能确定学生是否理解过程和判断。
dialogues.challenge: 提出允许工具但能看见独立能力的课程规则。
rows: A
A blanket ban seems simplest. Otherwise how do we know students learned anything?
全面禁止最简单，否则怎么知道学生学到东西？
B
A ban may drive use underground. Instead, ask students to explain their process, identify where tools helped, and defend key decisions in a short conversation.
禁令可能让使用转到暗处。不如让学生解释过程，说明工具帮助处，并用短谈话解释关键决定。
A
That would take more staff time.
这会多占教师时间。
B
Yes, so use focused checks rather than long conversations for every minor task.
对，所以重点检查，不为每个小任务做长谈话。
A
What kinds of assistance would you permit?
你会允许哪类帮助？
B
It should depend on the learning goal. Checking clarity may be reasonable when the goal is subject knowledge, but replacing the reasoning itself would defeat a task designed to develop reasoning.
应看学习目标。目标是学科知识时，检查清晰度可能合理；若任务练推理，工具替代推理本身就背离目的。
A
Then each task needs a clear explanation, not one vague university rule.
那每项任务需明确说明，不是一条模糊校规。
B
And fair access to approved tools, so the policy does not favor those who can pay.
也要公平获得允许的工具，政策不能偏向付得起钱的人。

dialogues.title: 工作里能不能用助手
dialogues.scene: 公司制定写作工具规则
dialogues.intent: 划定工具辅助与责任边界
dialogues.question: 哪些内容不应直接交给工具？
dialogues.answer: 敏感客户信息和未经核查的最终结论。
dialogues.challenge: 给团队解释三条可执行规则，并回应一个疑问。
rows: A
The writing assistant saves time. Can everyone start using it for client messages?
写作助手省时间，大家都能用于客户消息吗？
B
Only after we agree what information can be entered and who checks the output.
先商定什么信息能输入、谁检查输出才行。
A
We could forbid sensitive customer details.
可以禁止输入敏感客户资料。
B
Good. Also require the sender to verify facts and tone. A polished message can still invent a promise or sound inappropriate, and the client will hold us responsible rather than the tool.
好。还要发送者核实事实和语气。流畅消息仍可能编造承诺或语气不当，客户追究的是我们，不是工具。
A
Should staff disclose every use to customers?
员工每次用都要向客户说明吗？
B
Set clear expectations for significant use, and be honest when asked.
对重要使用设明确要求，被问时如实回答。
A
Let's trial it on low-risk internal drafts first.
先在低风险内部草稿上试行吧。
B
With examples of errors, so training covers judgment rather than just pressing a button.
配上错误案例，培训要练判断，不只练按按钮。

dialogues.title: 哪一种清洁能源更适合
dialogues.scene: 地方论坛比较能源项目
dialogues.intent: 综合不同维度而不机械排名
dialogues.question: 为什么不能只看发电量？
dialogues.answer: 还需土地、可靠性、成本和受影响者。
dialogues.challenge: 在两个方案中作有条件选择，主动说明一个代价。
rows: A
The solar proposal produces the most energy. Why consider the other two?
太阳能方案发电最多，为什么还考虑另外两个？
B
Because energy output is only one dimension. It needs more land, the wind project affects a different area, and the smaller rooftop plan can use existing buildings but produces less.
因为发电量只是一个维度。它要更多土地，风电影响另一区域，较小屋顶方案用现有建筑却产出较少。
A
Could we add the scores and choose the highest total?
能把分数相加选最高吗？
B
Only if the weights and units make sense, and people accept the priorities behind them.
要权重和单位合理，大家也接受背后的优先次序。
A
What would you recommend?
你会建议什么？
B

Start with suitable roofs while assessing the larger sites more carefully. That reduces immediate land pressure, but it is not a claim that rooftops alone meet future demand; storage and network capacity still matter.
先用合适屋顶，同时仔细评估大场地。可减少眼前土地压力，但不是说屋顶就够未来需求，储能和电网容量仍重要。
A
And consult people who live near the proposed sites before finalizing them.
也要定案前征求拟建场地附近居民意见。
B
Yes. A national benefit does not make local impacts disappear.
对。全国受益不会让本地影响消失。

dialogues.title: 老楼节能先改哪里
dialogues.scene: 业主比较改造措施
dialogues.intent: 根据目标与约束组合措施
dialogues.question: 为什么先处理保温？
dialogues.answer: 降低需求后可以选择更合适规模的设备。
dialogues.challenge: 预算只够两项，解释顺序及你还需确认的信息。
rows: A
I can buy better heating, replace windows, or add insulation. Which is best?
能换供暖、换窗或加保温，哪项最好？
B
First clarify the main problem. If heat escapes through the roof, buying a larger heater treats the symptom while leaving the loss. We should inspect the building before ranking the options.
先明确主要问题。如果热从屋顶散失，换大暖气只是治症状，热损失仍在。排名前先检查建筑。
A
The top floor is cold, and bills are high everywhere.
顶层很冷，各层账单都高。
B
That points toward heat loss, but an inspection is still needed.
那指向散热问题，但仍需检查。
A
Would insulation reduce the size of the new heating system we need?
保温会降低新供暖系统所需规模吗？
B
Potentially. Reducing demand first can change the equipment decision. We must also check ventilation and moisture, because saving energy should not create an unhealthy indoor environment.
可能。先降低需求能改变设备选择。也必须检查通风和湿气，节能不能带来不健康的室内环境。
A
Then a coordinated sequence may save more than separate purchases.
那协调的改造顺序可能比分别购买更省。
B
Exactly. Compare the whole plan and confirm what each estimate includes.
对。比较整体方案，确认每项估计包括什么。

dialogues.title: 归还之前该谈什么
dialogues.scene: 策展人与来源社区协商藏品
dialogues.intent: 公平复述争议并形成协议
dialogues.question: 保存能力能否直接决定所有权？
dialogues.answer: 不能，保存、取得历史和决定权是不同问题。
dialogues.challenge: 复述双方关切，再提出一步可执行的协议。
rows: A
We can preserve these objects well. Does returning them risk damage?
我们能妥善保存这些物品，归还有损坏风险吗？
B
Care matters, but it does not settle who should decide their future. We also need to examine how they were obtained and what they mean to the community they came from.
保存重要，但不能决定谁该掌握未来。也要检查取得方式，以及对来源社区的意义。
A
Some records are missing, so the history is not fully clear.
部分记录缺失，历史并不完全清楚。
B
Then acknowledge uncertainty and investigate together, rather than treating missing records as proof of consent.
那就承认不确定并共同调查，不能把记录缺失当作同意的证明。
A
Would shared research and a temporary loan be a reasonable first step?
共同研究和暂时借展是合理第一步吗？
B
Possibly, but the loan must not delay the ownership discussion indefinitely. Set a timetable, provide access to records, and agree who has authority at each stage.
可能，但借展不能无限拖延所有权讨论。设时间表、开放记录，并约定每阶段谁有决定权。
A
We should make the agreement visible to both communities.
应该让两边社区都能看到协议。
B
Yes. Trust depends on what the agreement actually changes, not only respectful language.
对。信任取决于协议真改变什么，不只看措辞尊重。

dialogues.title: 家族照片该放在哪里
dialogues.scene: 亲属协商历史照片
dialogues.intent: 区分保管与共享决定权
dialogues.question: 保管照片是否能独自决定公开？
dialogues.answer: 不能，应征求受影响家人的意见。
dialogues.challenge: 部分家人想展览，部分担心隐私，提出协议。
rows: A
I have kept the family photographs for years. I want to put them online.
这些家族照片我保管多年，想放到网上。
B
I appreciate the care, but keeping them does not mean deciding alone about everyone's image.
感谢你保管，但保管不意味着能独自决定所有人的肖像。
A
Many are historic. They could help the local archive.
许多有历史价值，可以帮助本地档案馆。
B

That is a worthwhile purpose. Still, some photographs show private events, and people may prefer limited access. We can distinguish a public selection from a family collection rather than choosing all or nothing.
目的有意义。不过有些是私人活动，大家可能希望限制访问。可以分公开精选和家族收藏，不必全有或全无。
A
Could we create digital copies and let relatives comment before publication?
能先制作电子副本，让亲属发表意见再公开吗？
B
Yes, and explain where the images will appear and how requests can be made.
能，并说明照片放哪里、怎样提出请求。
A
I'll record permission and keep the originals protected.
我会记录许可，并保护原件。
B
Then sharing the history can also respect the people within it.
那分享历史也能尊重历史里的人。

dialogues.title: 减废项目真的成功了吗
dialogues.scene: 食堂团队做最终评估
dialogues.intent: 综合记录、体验与后续行动
dialogues.question: 最终判断为何需要多个来源？
dialogues.answer: 重量下降不能单独说明满意度、成本和原因。
dialogues.challenge: 不用台词给出两分钟评估：结论、依据、局限和下一步。
rows: A
Food waste fell by a quarter. Can we call the project a success?
食物浪费减少四分之一，可以说项目成功吗？
B
It is encouraging, but fewer customers came during the holiday. We should compare waste per meal and separate kitchen waste from leftovers before deciding how much the changes contributed.
令人鼓舞，但假期顾客少了。应比较每餐浪费，区分厨房废料和剩餐，再判断措施贡献多少。
A
The customer survey is positive, though only a third replied.
顾客调查积极，不过只有三分之一回答。
B
Then report that limit and check whether complaints or requests for extra food changed.
那报告这一限制，并检查投诉或添餐请求有无变化。
A
After considering all that, what would you keep?
综合这些，你会保留什么？
B

Keep the smaller rice serving with free refills, improve ingredient ordering, and continue measurement for another month. I would delay further portion cuts until we know satisfaction and nutrition are not being harmed.
保留小份米饭免费续添，改进食材订购，再测一个月。确认满意度和营养没受影响前，不再缩小其他份量。
A
That gives us a conclusion without pretending every question is settled.
这样有结论，也没装作所有问题已解决。
B
Exactly. Good evaluation tells us what to do next and what to keep watching.
对。好的评估告诉我们下一步做什么、继续观察什么。

dialogues.title: 学了半年，接下来怎么走
dialogues.scene: 朋友回顾英语学习变化
dialogues.intent: 独立评估能力并规划迁移
dialogues.question: 学习者怎样证明进步而不只数课程？
dialogues.answer: 能听懂新情境、解释取舍并处理追问。
dialogues.challenge: 脱离本课说明自己的变化，举一个新情境并提出下月目标。
rows: A
You have listened for six months. What can you do now that you could not before?
你听了半年，现在能做哪些以前做不到的事？
B

I can follow familiar conversations without translating every sentence. More importantly, when plans change, I can explain a preference, ask for clarification, and stay in the conversation instead of freezing.
熟悉对话不必逐句翻译了。更重要的是，计划变化时，我能解释偏好、澄清并继续交谈，不再僵住。
A
What still feels difficult?
什么仍然困难？
B
Fast unfamiliar voices, and giving a detailed opinion when I have not prepared it.
快速的陌生声音，还有没准备时详细表达观点。
A
Then repeating only your favorite scenes may no longer be enough.
那只重复最喜欢的场景可能已经不够。
B

Right. Next month I will add unfamiliar speakers and discuss one real topic each week. I will keep useful repetition, but check whether I can respond to a new situation rather than merely remember a line.
对。下月加入陌生说话者，每周谈一个真实话题。保留有用重复，但检查能否回应新情况，不只记住台词。
A
Could we record a short conversation now and compare it later?
能现在录一段短对话，以后比较吗？
B
Yes. Clear examples of what I can do will guide me better than a lesson count.
能。清楚的能力例子比课程数量更能指导我。
